items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Turkey URL: https://sezzle.com The salary range for this role is $2,800 - $4,500 per month (Gross in USD) About Sezzle: With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! About the Role: We are seeking a talented and motivated, best-in-class Data Engineer II. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus. This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. You will partner with Customer Service to resolve technical dispute escalations, with Compliance to apply approved reporting requirements, and with Engineering when a fix is needed in production services or the consumer app. We are looking for an independent problem solver who can manage recurring reporting operations while improving the systems behind them. What You’ll Do: Own recurring credit bureau furnishing operations, including data preparation, validation, submissions, bureau feedback, exception resolution, and reconciliation Build, maintain, and debug SQL transformations, Python scripts, and data pipelines that produce credit reporting data Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses Identify all accounts affected by reporting defects, implement corrections and controlled reprocessing, and verify the resulting reporting outcomes Develop automated tests, reconciliations, monitoring, and alerts to catch inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected reporting before submission Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline Work with Compliance to translate approved reporting requirements into technical rules and escalate ambiguous reporting scenarios Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others What We Look For: Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline 3+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering Fluent in English Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. Preferred Knowledge and Skills: Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL The Tech You’ll Work With: Python Redshift, PostgreSQL Data build tool (dbt) WS, G Suite, Mac Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT Interview Process: Application submitted (you are here) Wonderlic test (30-40 min) Interview with recruiters (30 min) Online coding assessment focused on SQL, Python, and debugging Verbal case study interview. Walk through a credit reporting discrepancy, trace the data and code, and explain how you would correct and prevent the issue. Verbal behavioral interview. Share examples of independently resolving data incidents, improving reliability, and partnering with Engineering and Customer Service. Offer About You: You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire. #Li-remote #Full-time To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sezzle-data-engineer-ii-credit-reporting

items.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a “normalized” problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations Germany About the Role We are seeking an exceptional enterprise hunter to join our Strategic Sales Team as a Senior Majors Account Executive. Your primary mission is new logo acquisition: identifying, pursuing, and closing net-new business with Germany’s largest and most strategic enterprises. You will create opportunities where no existing relationship or active buying process exists, open doors at executive level, and establish Cloudflare as a long-term strategic platform partner. Expansion within a limited portfolio of existing Majors accounts will be secondary to winning new business. The ideal candidate combines a relentless prospecting mindset with sophisticated enterprise sales execution, executive presence, and genuine technical fluency, enabling credible engagement from the boardroom to CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Infrastructure. As a Senior Majors Account Executive, you will own your territory and target-account portfolio end-to-end. You will build multi-year account strategies, generate high-quality pipeline through direct outreach and the wider partner ecosystem, and orchestrate virtual deal teams across Customer Engineering, Product, Deal Desk, Legal, and Partners. You will lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, challenge customers’ thinking with a strong point of view, and consistently exceed new logo and new business targets. In line with Cloudflare’s AI-native culture, you will actively leverage AI tools across prospect research, territory prioritisation, executive outreach, account planning, meeting preparation, and pipeline management—using them as a genuine force multiplier in how you hunt and sell. Responsibilities New Logo Acquisition: Own the identification, pursuit, and closure of net-new Majors accounts as the primary focus of the role. Build pipeline proactively through personalised executive outreach, disciplined prospecting, ecosystem engagement, partner channels, industry networks, and referrals. Create demand rather than relying on inbound opportunities, and consistently bring significant new logos onto the Cloudflare platform. Strategic Account Planning: Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-year account plans for priority net-new targets and selected existing Majors accounts. Identify whitespace, strategic initiatives, power structures, buying processes, competitive dynamics, and potential entry points. Concentrate time and resources on the accounts and opportunities with the greatest potential for platform-wide adoption. Executive Relationship Management: Build trusted relationships at CISO, CIO, CTO, and board level, often starting without an existing Cloudflare presence. Develop broad, multi-threaded executive networks within target accounts and act as a strategic advisor by bringing relevant market insight, a compelling point of view, and clear business value—not simply responding to RFPs. Complex Sales Cycle Leadership: Lead sophisticated enterprise sales processes from initial engagement through contract signature. Navigate technical, security, legal, procurement, financial, and executive buying centres simultaneously. Establish clear mutual action plans, maintain control of deal momentum, qualification, and next steps, and advance opportunities with precision and appropriate urgency. Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding: Develop a thorough understanding of each prospect’s technology environment, including cloud strategy, network architecture, security posture, application landscape, data sovereignty, regulatory requirements, and AI infrastructure. Map Cloudflare’s platform capabilities to these environments through relevant Reference Architectures, positioning comprehensive platform adoption rather than isolated point solutions. Virtual Deal Team Leadership: Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of Customer Engineers, Product Managers, Deal Desk, Legal, Partners, and other specialists to win complex, high-value opportunities. Align resources around a differentiated strategy, proactively remove blockers, and deliver a consistently excellent prospect experience throughout the sales cycle. AI-Powered Sales Execution: Use AI tools deliberately and consistently to improve the quality and velocity of your sales execution. Apply them to account research, hypothesis development, stakeholder mapping, personalised executive outreach, meeting preparation, competitive analysis, pipeline inspection, and follow-up. Continuously experiment with new ways to make your territory management and customer engagement sharper and more effective. Digital Transformation & AI Positioning: Serve as a credible partner to enterprises navigating digital, cloud, security, and AI-driven transformation. Understand how AI adoption is reshaping infrastructure, compliance, security, and competitive dynamics. Position Cloudflare capabilities—including AI Gateway, Workers AI, and Zero Trust for AI workloads—as strategic enablers ofcustomers’ long-term transformation agendas. Expert Pipeline & Forecasting: Build and maintain sufficient high-quality pipeline to consistently achieve ambitious new business targets. Deliver accurate, evidence-based account and opportunity forecasts to sales leadership, with clear visibility into qualification, deal status, risks, stakeholder alignment, and required actions. Apply rigorous inspection and honest judgement across long and complex enterprise sales cycles. Advanced Negotiation & Closure: Lead complex commercial and contractual negotiations with confidence and discipline. Construct compelling, outcome-linked value propositions tied directly to each customer’s strategic objectives. Secure commercially strong, sustainable agreements while protecting long-term customer value and Cloudflare’s position as a strategic platform partner. Trusted Advisor & Organisational Contribution: Share field intelligence, competitive insight, and winning practices openly across the German and wider international teams. Contribute to Cloudflare’s understanding of the German Majors market, partner with colleagues to improve execution, and elevate the performance of those around you through coaching, collaboration, and example. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience 8+ years of experience selling complex technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model, with a substantial track record of consistently exceeding multi-million-euro new business and quota targets in a Majors, strategic, or named account environment. Proven enterprise hunter: Demonstrated success opening and closing large, complex net-new accounts, including opportunities created without inherited relationships, inbound demand, or an active customer-initiated buying process. A consistent history of personal pipeline generation , including disciplined prospecting, executive outreach, account-based selling, and effective use of partners and industry networks to access senior decision-makers. Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security (Zero Trust, SASE, SSE), Connectivity, Developer Platforms, and Edge Computing , with the ability to engage credibly with CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and senior infrastructure leaders. Proven ability to understand complex enterprise IT architectures and map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures, connecting technical differentiation to measurable business outcomes and platform-wide adoption. Demonstrated success navigating complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles across procurement, legal, information security, technical, financial, and executive buying centres. Demonstrated use of AI tools in a sales context, such as prospect research, executive outreach personalisation, account planning, stakeholder mapping, meeting preparation, or pipeline managemen t. You can explain specifically how AI has made you faster, sharper, or more effective. Familiarity with AI transformation trends and their infrastructure, security, sovereignty, and compliance implications, with the ability to position Cloudflare’s AI platform capabilities as strategic enablers for large enterprises. Exceptional executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to challenge senior stakeholders constructively, hold the room, and connect platform capabilities to board-level priorities. Advanced negotiation skills and a track record of closing six-figure and multi-million-euro net-new transactions involving complex commercial, technical, and contractual requirements. Proficiency in Salesforce CRM and disciplined pipeline management; MEDDPICC methodology strongly preferred , with evidence of applying rigorous qualification rather than simply documenting it. Experience selling into large German or DACH enterprises, particularly regulated or complex industries such as financial services, insurance, automotive, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, energy, telecommunications, or critical infrastructure. Familiarity with requirements such as GDPR, NIS2, and sector-specific regulation is advantageous. Proficiency in modern sales, productivity, and business intelligence platforms, such as Salesforce, Tableau, Google Workspace. Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, competitive, and resilient, with the persistence to build strategic opportunities over long sales cycles and the judgement to disqualify opportunities that are unlikely to convert. Ability to travel as required to engage with customers, partners, and internal teams across Germany and internationally. Language Skills: Executive-level fluency in German and English, with the ability to prospect, present, negotiate, and build trusted C-suite relationships in both languages. Compensation For Germany based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €202,000 - €278,000. This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan. Equity: This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person’s, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer. Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

items.description: Data Architecture & Governance Designs scalable and reusable data architectures to support transversal use across multiple domains and systems. Leads the definition and standardization of enterprise-wide common data models (submissions, cases, products, etc.). Develops and enforces data governance policies to support consistent, high-quality, and compliant data usage. Data Quality, Classification & Retention Establishes data quality controls, validation frameworks, and monitoring mechanisms across key datasets. Defines and implements data classification standards and integrates them into data cataloguing solutions. Supports the implementation and enforcement of data retention and lifecycle policies in alignment with regulatory and business needs. API Design & Integration Defines API contracts and facilitates alignment between producers and consumers of data services. Ensures APIs reflect well-defined and reusable data models, enabling efficient integration across teams and systems. Leads integration efforts with enterprise data platforms, ensuring data flows are secure, traceable, and optimised. Testing, Documentation & Support Designs test data strategies for validating data pipelines and ensuring robustness of data-dependent applications. Supports, suggests and applies methods for the creation of synthetic data for testing purposes. Ensures technical documentation of data models, data flows, and integration points is maintained and accessible. Supports platform teams and domain owners by advising on best practices in using shared data assets and APIs. Technical Design and Implementation Translates business and platform needs into scalable, secure, and maintainable data architecture designs. Supports resolution of legacy data issues, including schema harmonization, normalization, and versioning. Security, Compliance & Risk Management Ensures data solutions adhere to security and compliance standards, including data privacy, access control, and regulatory requirements. Collaborates with data protection and legal teams to ensure the architecture supports compliance-by-design principles. Agile Collaboration & Continuous Improvement Actively participates in SAFe Agile ceremonies, supporting backlog refinement, planning, and reviews. REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Engineering or a related field. Proven experience as a Data Architect or in a similar role focused on enterprise data architecture, data modelling, and platform integration. Solid understanding of modern data architecture patterns, including data Lakehouse, event-driven architectures, and API-based data access. Familiarity with Agile development methodologies, particularly SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework). Extensive experience designing and maintaining common data models across large-scale enterprise systems (e.g., submissions, cases, products). Experience implementing data governance frameworks, retention policies, and classification schemes. Strong background in API design and the definition of clear and reusable API contracts between systems. Proven experience integrating data systems with external platforms, data hubs, and pipelines. Experience with testing frameworks for data, including generating and managing synthetic or representative test data. Demonstrated ability to assess, document, and resolve technical debt in data pipelines and data models. Experience with metadata management, data cataloguing tools, and improving data discoverability and reusability. Level: Senior Delivery mode: Remote from Europe (flexibility to travel to Amsterdam for Client’s meetings occasionally). Europass CV format only EU Citizens Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - MX Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. The Opportunity As a Sr. Data Engineer at Oportun, you will be a key member of our team, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining sophisticated software / data platforms in achieving the charter of the engineering group. Your mastery of a technical domain enables you to take up business problems and solve them with a technical solution. With your depth of expertise and leadership abilities, you will actively contribute to architectural decisions, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions that advance our impact in the market. This is a role where you will have the opportunity to take up responsibility in leading the technology effort – from technical requirements gathering to final successful delivery of the product - for large initiatives (cross-functional and multi-month-long projects). At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll design and implement scalable, efficient, and reliable data architectures that support business and analytical needs. You’ll build and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes, and integration solutions for large volumes of structured and unstructured data. You’ll optimize data pipelines, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes for performance, reliability, scalability, and security. You’ll partner with stakeholders to understand data requirements, develop domain expertise, and translate business needs into effective data models and solutions. You’ll establish and improve data quality standards, validation rules, documentation, and governance practices. You’ll implement monitoring and observability practices to identify bottlenecks, improve performance, and strengthen platform reliability. You’ll provide technical leadership on architecture, scalability, reliability, monitoring, integration, and extensibility. You’ll lead and contribute to code reviews, helping maintain high standards for code quality, performance, and maintainability. You’ll mentor junior engineers and support a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. You’ll take ownership of production issues, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, escalation, and long-term resolution. You’ll independently lead multiple features and projects, coordinate work across engineers, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and dependencies. You’ll help evolve engineering tools, platforms, and practices and encourage adoption of better ways of working. You’ll look for practical ways to use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, analysis, documentation, and problem-solving. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a hands-on data engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building systems that others depend on. You combine strong technical depth with a practical understanding of business needs and know how to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable leading technical work without relying on formal authority. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams make stronger technical decisions. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 8+ years of experience in data engineering, with strong experience in data architecture, ETL, and database management. Strong programming skills in Python or PySpark, plus experience with Java or Scala. Experience building complex end-to-end data pipelines and data integration solutions. Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies. Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or similar platforms. Experience with orchestration and scheduling tools such as Airflow, Databricks, Jenkins, or similar technologies. Experience designing and operating scalable, reliable, and secure data systems. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and associated data services. Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Lean, or Kanban. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to technical leadership within a team. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. Nice to Have Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. Databricks experience or certification. Experience with AWS Redshift, S3, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, or comparable cloud data services. Experience implementing data governance, data quality, or observability frameworks. Experience leading cross-functional or multi-month engineering initiatives. Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, troubleshooting, documentation, or productivity. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: Mexico Benefits: Medical Insurance Savings Fund and Life Insurance Vacation and Parental Leave Internet and Electricity Allowance Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-GK1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-sr-data-analytics-engineer-r14153

ClickGuard will run four motions on the same stack: a self-serve trial, a sales-assisted motion for
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://www.clickguard.com/ We are seeking a hands-on, systems-driven RevOps Manager to own the data, tools, and processes behind every stage of our revenue funnel: signup, trial, paid, renewal, expansion, and churn. ClickGuard will run four motions on the same stack: a self-serve trial, a sales-assisted motion for larger advertisers, outbound to advertisers and PPC agencies, and an agency partner program. This role makes sure a trial, a paying customer, and a dollar of MRR are counted the same way in HubSpot, Stripe, PostHog, and every report built on them. This is an AI-first operations role for someone who has personally built revenue systems that leadership used to run the business, and who uses AI to do the work of a larger ops team. You will own our CRM, our funnel data, the weekly revenue scorecard, and the workflows that move accounts from one stage to the next. Your superpower is turning messy, disconnected data into numbers people act on. You treat RevOps as a data and systems problem first, and an admin problem second. Every workflow you build has an owner, a test, and an alert when it breaks, so a broken lead flow shows up in your inbox the same day it breaks and gets fixed before it reaches the quarter-end numbers. Using AI tools is the baseline. We want someone who can show what they have personally built with AI, how it changed their workflow or capacity, and what measurable impact it had on data quality, speed, conversion, revenue, or headcount efficiency. What You'll Own HubSpot end-to-end: object model (contacts, companies, workspaces, deals, tickets), lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, workflows, and permissions, with one owner per field and every critical workflow tested and monitored The revenue data layer (built with our engineering and data team): the app, Stripe, and HubSpot feeding PostHog, with shared definitions for trial, paid, MRR, churn, expansion, and reactivation that every report uses Funnel instrumentation and attribution: source captured at signup, account qualification by measured ad spend, and a clear trail from first touch to trial to paid to renewal AI-powered RevOps systems at scale: build and operate workflows where AI materially increases throughput across enrichment, routing, lead and account scoring, health scoring, data hygiene, and reporting. You should be able to demonstrate systems you have personally built and the business results they produced. The weekly revenue scorecard for the leadership meeting, pulled from source data; and the operating processes behind sales and customer success: quote and discount approvals, agency account handovers, refunds, chargebacks, and failed-payment recovery. You're a Fit If You've personally rebuilt a CRM that a revenue team relied on, and you can show the before and after: workflows fixed, fields retired, duplicate records merged, and reports leadership started to trust. You have built real AI-powered workflows and can show what you built, where AI sat in the workflow, what it automated or augmented, and the measurable impact it created. You understand subscription revenue well enough to reconcile MRR between Stripe and the CRM, and to explain why the two numbers differ Hands-on with HubSpot (Operations Hub or equivalent), SQL, CLI, API’s, Webhooks, n8n/Make, and Claude Code or Codex You can explain lifecycle stages, deal pipelines, and attribution models without Googling You treat product usage as revenue data: trial activity, connected ad accounts, and plan limits feed scoring and routing You're Not a Fit If Your experience is mostly building dashboards on top of data someone else had to fix You measure success in workflows built and tickets closed rather than conversion and revenue You need a team around you; this role is the builder for our foundation Required Skills & Experience 3-5+ Years in RevOps or Revenue Systems: Proven experience owning the CRM and revenue data for a B2B SaaS company, ideally one with a self-serve trial or product-led motion. You can show the numbers: data completeness, workflow reliability, funnel conversion, forecast accuracy, and time saved. CRM Architecture: Concrete experience designing an object model, lifecycle stages, and pipelines from scratch, or rebuilding a broken one, including migrations that keep the history intact. You document every field you create and retire the ones nobody uses. Data Ownership: You have personally owned the path from source system to report: event tracking, warehouse tables, SQL, and reconciliation against billing. When two systems disagree, you find out why before anyone reports the number. AI-Native Execution: You have personally built AI-powered systems inside a revenue workflow, including enrichment, scoring, routing, classification, data cleanup, forecasting, or agentic workflows. You can clearly explain what you built, why you built it, how it worked, and what measurable result it produced in terms of pipeline, revenue, productivity, speed, quality, or reduced manual work. Full-Funnel Accountability: You measure your work through the full chain from signup → trial → qualified account → paid → renewal → expansion. You can show examples where a process you built moved conversion or retention. You are comfortable killing your own workflows when the data says they are not helping. Cross-Team Range: Ability to work with sales, customer success, marketing, finance, and engineering: you write specs an engineer can build from and processes a sales rep will follow. Technical Proficiency HubSpot CRM Ecosystem: (Expert Level) Custom objects, associations, workflows, lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, lists, permissions, and the HubSpot API. SQL & Product Analytics: (Working Level) Comfortable writing SQL against a warehouse (PostHog or equivalent) and joining product events with billing and CRM data. Billing Systems: Working fluency with Stripe: subscriptions, invoices, coupons, failed payments, and how each one shows up in MRR. Enrichment & Data APIs: Clay or equivalent, people and company data providers, and comfort consuming REST APIs and webhooks directly. Automation Engineering: Strong execution knowledge of workflow automation (n8n, Make, or native AI-agent integrations) and AI coding tools (Claude Code or Codex), connecting the stack without engineering support. Logistics Remote, async-first team culture. Must have overlapping availability for live syncs between 7 AM and 2 PM EST . Full-time, long-term position. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/clickguard-inc-revops-manager

items.description: Company Description Netcompany is one of Europe’s leading technology partners, with more than 9,500 colleagues delivering digital solutions for governments, critical industries and businesses across Europe. We take responsibility for the full journey, from strategy and development to daily operations. As Europe’s leader in sovereign AI, we build technology on Europe’s own terms. AI is a natural part of how we build solutions. We use it in business-critical systems through a proven delivery model where human judgement, transparency, security and accountability matter from design to daily operations. AI-related roles include roles clearly involving AI, machine learning, data science, generative AI, LLMs, AI automation, AI governance or AI architecture. Job Description We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented PMO Analyst to support the Healthcare portfolio in delivering effective project governance, reporting, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical skills with a collaborative approach to drive operational excellence across multiple projects. Key Responsibilities: Support Delivery Leads and Senior Management with project coordination, reporting, and administration. Prepare and distribute meeting materials, action logs, and status reports. Maintain project documentation, charters, schedules, and risk registers. Track and report on budgets, forecasts, KPIs, risks, and issues. Manage dependencies, constraints, and resource capacity planning. Develop dashboards and executive summaries for stakeholder updates. Ensure adherence to PMO standards, methodologies, and frameworks. Implement and maintain PMO tools, templates, and best practices. Lead financial and commercial reporting to monitor spend and headroom. Coordinate training, recruitment, and change management activities. Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives across the portfolio. Qualifications Proven experience in a PMO or Project Support role. Strong analytical and Excel skills, experience with reporting tools (e.g. Power BI etc) is a plus. Understanding of project management methodologies (e.g., PRINCE2, Agile) Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities under own direction. Experience with Project Management tools (e.g. MS Project, Jira, Sharepoint etc) Knowledge of portfolio management and resource planning. Relevant certifications are a plus (e.g. P3O, PMO Practitioner etc) Proven capability to generate detailed reports and dashboards for accurate tracking of project / Portfolio progress and metrics Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, are imperative for effective collaboration and stakeholder management. Additional Information Build on your experience and keep developing Your development continues through the responsibility you take, the projects you lead and the people you learn from. As part of a structured career model, you’ll build on the experience you already bring, supported by a personal mentor from the leadership group who can help guide your professional development, career direction and personal goals. Be part of a shared community Community is built through the way we work together. You’ll join teams where collaboration, trust and support are part of everyday work. We bring together colleagues with different backgrounds, identities, cultures and experiences, ensuring everyone is met with respect and has equal opportunities to develop and thrive. Driven by responsible digitalisation We believe digitalisation creates the most value when it is done responsibly. We build solutions that are secure, transparent, and designed to create lasting impact for people, businesses, and society. Responsibility is embedded in how we design, develop, and deliver every solution. Benefits include Hybrid working model with some flexible working 25 days’ holiday Private Medical Health care via Vitality Pension contribution, Life Assurance Professional certifications supported as part of learning and development. A range of retail discounts to enhance your lifestyle, encompassing restaurants, supermarkets, travel, leisure activities and health and well-being services. items.description: Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we’re now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation. Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun! Minimum qualifications 8+ years of experience leading Partner Marketing, Channel Marketing, or Alliance Marketing in enterprise B2B SaaS or cybersecurity. 5+ years of experience leading high-performing, global teams. Experience designing and executing comprehensive To, With, and Through partner marketing strategies across resellers, CSPs, GSIs, and channel partners. Experience collaborating cross-functionally and leading in a global matrixed environment. Preferred qualifications Strong experience with partner marketing and event marketing programs at scale. Deep familiarity with marketing tech stacks, including Salesforce, Marketo, Tableau, and Looker. Ability to analyze and act on data to drive smarter decisions and continuous improvement. A bias for action, a builder’s mindset, and a deep sense of accountability. About the job As the Head of Partner Marketing, you will lead a high-performing global team across all partner types (resellers, services, MSPs, CSPs, GSIs, and Integration partners). You’ll be responsible for shaping and executing our comprehensive global partner marketing strategy across To-Partner, With-Partner, and Through-Partner motions to drive partner-sourced pipeline growth, broaden brand awareness, and accelerate ecosystem revenue. This role is core to our global go-to-market strategy, driving scale through structured co-marketing frameworks, enablement, and joint demand generation across existing and expanding global regions. Responsibilities Lead global strategy across To-Partner enablement, With-Partner joint positioning, and Through-Partner demand generation engines for resellers, CSPs, GSIs, and technology partners. Lead, scale, and mentor a high-performing team of partner marketing managers covering global cloud, channel, and technology partners. Establish a Partner Marketing Center of Excellence to deliver repeatable To-Partner communications, Through-Partner campaign kits, and With-Partner joint solution messaging for resellers and strategic partners. Partner closely with Alliances and Channel Sales leadership to align marketing motions with key partner account goals and revenue targets. Design and execute joint demand generation campaigns and co-marketing programs across strategic CSPs, GSIs, regional resellers, and channel partners. Manage partner MDF (Market Development Funds) programs, ensuring strategic allocation, ROI tracking, and compliance across all joint marketing initiatives. Oversee presence and sponsorship strategy at major partner summits, ecosystem conferences, and regional reseller partner events. Drive cross-functional integration with Product Marketing, Field Marketing, Corporate Comms, and Revenue Operations to amplify partner wins and joint value propositions. Establish metrics and dashboards to measure partner marketing ROI, pipeline contribution, and ecosystem velocity. Ensure all field programs are aligned with Wiz’s brand, values, and commitment to customer success. Drive regional expansion initiatives, including dedicated event execution, scaling pipeline engines across new markets, and leading regional launch programs. Compensation + Benefits Compensation for this full-time position includes base salary + bonus + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits. Learn more about benefits at Google. The US base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. US Base Pay Range $171,000—$234,000 USD Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country where the position is based, without the need for visa sponsorship. This role does not offer visa sponsorship. Wiz is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wiz will process your personal data in accordance with Wiz’s Privacy Policy.

items.summary: this is your role At TradeTracker. com, we are dedicated to delivering innovative software solutions that meet the needs of our clients and drive business growth.
items.description: this is your role At TradeTracker .com, we are dedicated to delivering innovative software solutions that meet the needs of our clients and drive business growth. We are seeking an experienced Product Development Manager with a strong foundation in Advertising Technology (3+ years) and demonstrated leadership in SaaS product development . Your cover letter must highlight relevant adtech, SaaS, and gamification experience, demonstrating why these make you an exceptional fit for this role. Applications missing this information cannot be processed. Key Responsibilities As a Product Development Manager, you will be at the forefront of our product innovation. Your primary responsibility is to ensure that our products are designed and developed to meet the highest standards of quality and performance. You will lead efforts to understand market demands, identify opportunities for improvement, and work with various teams to deliver solutions that enhance our product offerings. You will report directly to the Head of Product, ensuring alignment with overall company goals and strategy. Product Design and Documentation: Actively create and maintain clear, detailed documentation for new products and features, including functional descriptions, flowcharts, and mockups. You will translate complex product ideas into easy-to-understand visuals and written materials, providing a blueprint that guides development and enhances cross-functional understanding. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, data engineers, and product managers, to deliver high-impact products. Your role will involve coordinating efforts across these teams to ensure that product development is seamless and efficient, fostering a collaborative environment. Product-Market Fit: Continuously assess and address client needs to ensure that our products maintain their relevance and effectiveness in the market. This involves staying updated on market trends, gathering client feedback, and making data-driven decisions to refine and improve our products. You will also need to understand SaaS interfaces, dashboards, charts, and reports to create user-friendly and insightful products. your profile To excel in this role, you need a blend of experience, technical knowledge, and analytical skills. These qualifications will enable you to understand the market, make informed decisions, and drive the development of successful products. Experience: Proven experience as a Product Manager or in a similar role within the advertising or software development fields. You should have a track record of successfully managing and launching products that meet market needs and drive business growth. SaaS Expertise: Good understanding of SaaS interfaces, dashboards, charts, and reports. This expertise is essential for developing user-friendly products that provide valuable insights and drive user engagement. AdTech Knowledge: A deep understanding of the online advertising technology landscape, including customer needs and market dynamics. Experience and knowledge in AdTech and online advertising are crucial. Knowledge and experience with affiliate marketing are a plus. Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze market data, interpret insights, and make informed decisions. This involves using data to prioritize product features, measure performance, and guide the product development process. You should also be comfortable with SaaS analytics and reporting tools to extract meaningful insights. Rapid Prototyping: Knowledge and experience with rapid prototyping techniques to quickly iterate and refine product concepts. This is crucial for fast-paced development cycles and ensuring that ideas are effectively translated into functional designs. We are looking for someone who not only meets the skill requirements but also brings additional qualities that will help drive our success. Your proficiency with tools, experience in scope management, and ability to lead and inspire are critical for this role. Product Management Tools: Proficient in using product management tools and methodologies such as Atlassian Product Discovery. These tools help streamline the product development process, ensure all team members are aligned, and facilitate efficient project management. Scope Management: Experience in transferring scope from Product Management to Product Owners for product development. This skill ensures that product development is focused and efficient, with clear responsibilities and timelines, leading to successful project execution. Wireframing & Prototyping: Familiarity with high-level wireframing and prototyping techniques. This allows you to create initial design concepts that can be tested and refined before full-scale development, ensuring that the final product meets user needs and expectations. Productivity & Quality: We expect high productivity and a work mentality based on productivity-focused work. Your performance should consistently result in high-quality products that are superior to those offered by our competitors. Visionary Thinker: A forward-thinking leader with the ability to inspire people and drive teams toward achieving strategic goals. Your vision and leadership will be crucial in guiding the product development process and achieving business objectives. If you are passionate about AdTech and have the expertise to lead product development in a dynamic environment, we would love to hear from you. Join us at TradeTracker .com and be part of a team that is shaping the future of performance marketing. why us? At TradeTracker .com, we're a leading global affiliate marketing platform that empowers advertisers and publishers to succeed in the digital marketing landscape. Our cutting-edge technology and commitment to excellence make us the preferred choice for businesses worldwide. Being at the forefront of technology and monetization models, we encourage creativity and a winner’s mindset. Be a part of a leading company in the fast-evolving affiliate marketing landscape. Work in a dynamic, innovative environment where your ideas can truly make a difference. Join a team of passionate professionals dedicated to excellence and continuous improvement. Enjoy a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and a flexible working arrangement. Embrace the opportunity to grow your career in a company that values creativity, innovation, and results. Join our dynamic team at TradeTracker .com and be part of a fast-paced, innovative environment where your skills will be put to the test. If you're passionate about creating products the market want but may not even be aware about, we want to hear from you. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: Remote; Tokyo Senior Support Engineer Team: Customer Engineering and Success, CircleCI About the team Support Engineering is part of Customer Engineering and Success at CircleCI. We give technical support to customers after they buy. Our team works around the clock across North America, Asia Pacific, and Europe. We build and manage AI agents that answer customer questions and solve technical problems. People step in when a problem needs deeper work. We also share what we learn with Product and Engineering to make CircleCI better. About the role Senior Support Engineers take on the hardest customer problems and incidents. You help set how our AI support agents handle those problems, and you step in when agents cannot. You also mentor teammates and help the team grow its skills. You use AI tools every day. You check all AI output, and you help others on the team do the same. What you will do Design, build, and improve AI support agents. Measure how well they work. Own the hardest customer problems from start to finish, including those agents cannot solve. Lead the team during incidents. Keep customers informed with clear and timely updates. Review AI-assisted work from teammates and coach them. Mentor teammates. Share what you know so that no single person is the only expert. Check new product features for how easy they will be to support. Work with Product and Engineering to fix problems early. Set team goals. Improve team processes and help content. Advocate for customer experience with Product and Engineering. Meet response targets on the cases you own. You describe what the product can and cannot do. We do not oversell. Join the on-call rotation. What you need More than 3 years in technical product support or software engineering. You have solved complex problems. Hands-on experience building or running AI tools, workflows, or agents. You review results for accuracy. Skill at tracing failures across services in cloud or distributed systems. You read logs and test ideas to find the cause. Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. You have used tools like kubectl to find why an application or cluster is failing. Experience supporting self-hosted or on-premises software. You have used tools like Helm and support bundles to find why an installation is failing. Hands-on experience with build, test, and deploy automation. You have written automated tests and set up a CI/CD pipeline for a project. Experience running self-hosted build runners on Linux, Windows, macOS, or Arm, including in networks with limited access. Experience with SDLC practices and related tooling; infrastructure as code (such as Terraform), CI/CD, Git, and Linux. Experience working with API programmatically, scripting against them with a CLI or SDK. You can write scripts to reproduce problems. Knowledge of networking and security. Experience troubleshooting single sign-on (SSO), OAuth, and access controls. You have worked with identity providers and code-hosting sign-in. Experience mentoring other engineers. Clear writing and speaking. You can handle sensitive customer situations calmly. Experience working across time zones, with clear handoffs. Nice to have Experience with AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure, including OIDC trust policies. Advanced experience with observability, tracing and monitoring tools. Experience connecting AI tools to company data and systems. Knowledge of iOS application testing and code signing. Experience with security response, such as vulnerability (CVE) triage, certificate problems, or abuse reports. Experience querying data with SQL and building dashboards. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. About CircleCI CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital. CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you. Where we may use AI Job descriptions and messaging : AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate. Application review : For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications. Interview notes : With advance notice, an AI note-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected. Outreach : AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending. Our commitment AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change. Your choices You can ask for human-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact recruiting@circleci.com . For how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/circleci-senior-support-engineer

Backend services, identity, analytics, meta-game sys
items.description: Product Headquarters: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States URL: https://www.skillz.com About Beamable Beamable is the backend and LiveOps infrastructure platform for game developers, the system that lets studios build, operate, and scale live games without constructing the underlying architecture themselves. Backend services, identity, analytics, meta-game systems, virtual economies, and AI-native tooling: all integrated into a single platform that eliminates the point-solution stitching that has defined game development for too long. Beamable also powers Wingman, an agentic LiveOps product that gives game teams a unified operating system to understand, optimize, and act on live game performance in real time. This is the future of how games are operated. Beamable is part of FIRY , a founder-led global technology portfolio operating at the intersection of gaming, AI-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Acquired in January 2026, and together with Skillz, our competition platform, and RZR , our AI-driven ad network, Beamable sits at the foundation of a compounding ecosystem that no standalone competitor can replicate. If you want to build the infrastructure that games run on at a company with the vision and resources to back it — Beamable is the right place to do it. About the Role Beamable is seeking a Head of Product to shape its platform vision and lead its next phase of growth in the game backend market. This is an opportunity to build the product function from the ground up, guide the platform from early access through public release, and advance AI integration to deliver meaningful value for game studios. As the company’s senior product leader and sole product practitioner, you will own product strategy, roadmap, launch milestones, and success metrics, combining strategic direction with hands-on execution. You will work directly with studios and design partners, represent Beamable’s product vision at industry events, and translate customer insights into clear priorities. Success in this role means delivering a successful public launch, developing early-access studios into reference customers, and establishing a product foundation that drives adoption and sustained revenue growth. Responsibilities Product Strategy & Vision Ownership. Set the product vision for Beamable’s platform — spanning player engagement, developer tools, data enrichment, and player intelligence — and own the roadmap from early access through public release and beyond. Partner with the CRO on packaging, pricing, and tracking the studio funnel quantitatively. Public Release & Launch Execution. Drive Beamable’s product through its launch milestones: early design partners, public release, and strategic partnerships. Define and own the go/no-go criteria for each milestone, ensuring the product ships when it’s ready to win. Studio Partnership & Customer Discovery. Spend meaningful time every week with studios, design partners, and game developers — running discovery calls, demos, onboarding sessions, and roadmap reviews. Join sales calls and paid pilots with the CRO and turn each design partner into a reference case. AI Integration & Product Intelligence. Define the guardrails, data policies, and feedback loops that make Beamable’s AI capabilities safe, effective, and trustworthy for game teams. Integrate with best-in-class tools studios already use and shape the intelligent systems that differentiate the platform. Metrics Ownership & Product Function Build-Out. Define success metrics across the studio lifecycle — time to value, pilot conversion, retention, usage, and revenue per studio — and do your own analysis in SQL. Establish the product processes Beamable runs on: discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch reviews. Key Competencies Platform Product Strategy. Proven ability to set and execute product vision for a developer-facing platform, owning the strategy across multiple capability areas simultaneously — not just a feature set. Customer-Facing Product Leadership. Equally credible with studio heads, producers, and engineers. Comfortable running a demo, leading a discovery call, supporting a sale, and representing the product at industry events including GDC and Gamescom. Gaming Live-Ops Domain Expertise. Deep understanding of what a studio’s growth or live-ops team does day-to-day — events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, and player data — and what slows them down. AI/ML Product Judgment. Experience shipping AI or ML-driven features to production. Knows where AI adds genuine value, where it needs guardrails, and how to define data policies that serve both studio needs and platform integrity. Data Fluency & Metrics Ownership. Can build dashboards, write SQL, and live with retention, churn, and revenue metrics over time. Runs experiments before big bets rather than after. 0-to-1 Startup Product Leadership. Comfortable being the only PM in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment. Has built product processes from scratch and can hold the strategy and the execution at the same time. Technical Depth. Conversant in data warehouses, APIs, SDKs, and system design. Can earn the respect of engineers and studio technical leads without needing a dedicated translator. Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Design, or a related field; equivalent experience considered. 10+ years in product management, including experience as a product lead or head of product owning a product line’s strategy — not just a feature set. Proven experience in gaming live-ops — either running live games or building tools for teams that do: events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, or player data. Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup as a solo or founding PM, with demonstrated comfort operating in ambiguity with shifting priorities. At least one AI or ML-driven feature shipped to production and used by real customers. Demonstrated data fluency: SQL, product analytics tools, and a track record of living with business metrics over time to drive decisions. Experience with customer engagement platforms (Braze, CleverTap), game backends (PlayFab, Nakama, Unity Gaming Services), or data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery) preferred. Experience taking a product from early access to public launch preferred. Total Starting Compensation including Base + Bonus + Equity: $212,625 + Bonus + Equity Location: Remote - CA, NV, or NY Travel Requirement: Less than 10% Why Beamable Comprehensive Benefits. 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. 401K matching, equity incentives, pre-tax benefit options, and more. Wellness Support. Meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, virtual therapy sessions, and more. Time Off. Competitive PTO and company holidays. Beamable embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with applicable fair chance ordinances. #GC-Remote #GC-1 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/firy-head-of-product-beamable

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b Position: Business Development and Client Engagement Manager Salary: Php 80,000 to Php 100,000/month Working Hours & Conditions: AU Working Hours and Holidays Employment: Full Time - Independent Contractor ABOUT THE COMPANY: The company is dedicated to transforming lives through high-quality, person-centred care. Operating across Western Australia, we deliver trusted Supported Independent Living (SIL), community participation, and specialised support services designed to empower participants and foster long-term independence. Our culture is rooted in genuine empathy, rigorous service standards, and collaborative community partnerships. ROLE OVERVIEW: We are seeking an ambitious, results-driven Business Development and Client Engagement Manager to spearhead our market expansion and drive participant intake across Perth and the wider Western Australian region. Reporting directly to leadership and collaborating closely with the Operations Manager, you will operate as an "A+ Hunter"—proactively identifying referral opportunities, cultivating strategic relationships across the disability and healthcare ecosystems, and managing the end-to-end conversion cycle. This is an autonomous, high-impact field sales role where your commercial acumen, networking capability, and relentless follow-through will directly translate into sustainable service growth and full SIL occupancy. RESPONSIBILITIES: Strategic Outreach & Referral Generation Conduct outbound prospecting to identify and secure referral streams across Perth and Western Australia. Build and nurture strong professional relationships with Support Coordinators, Psychosocial Recovery Coaches, hospital discharge teams, allied health professionals, mental health networks, and justice-transition services. Coordinate and attend targeted field visits and partner meetings to pitch service offerings and establish sustainable intake pipelines. Lead Management & Conversion Respond rapidly to participant enquiries (acknowledgement within 2 business hours) and drive structured lead qualification. Organise and facilitate participant intake meetings, service suitability assessments, and accommodation inspections. Collaborate closely with the Operations Manager to verify service capacity, staffing logistics, and participant matching before finalising agreements. Draft accurate service proposals, quotations, and service agreements, driving follow-ups to achieve prompt execution. SIL Vacancy Management & Service Expansion Actively market and promote available Supported Independent Living (SIL) vacancies across relevant networks. Coordinate property viewings, engage with families and decision-makers, and support safe, appropriate participant compatibility matching. Pinpoint emerging service demands in regional and metropolitan catchments to advise on future property and service expansions. Pipeline Governance & Reporting Maintain daily, end-to-end data integrity within the CRM—logging contacts, meeting outcomes, lead stages, and next actions. Deliver weekly pipeline updates, conversion analysis, and field-activity schedules every Monday by 10:00 AM. Produce monthly performance reviews evaluating channel effectiveness, onboarding numbers, SIL occupancy, and revenue growth. Experience: Minimum of 2 years of professional B2B business development, sales, or client acquisition experience within Australia. Industry Acumen: Sound working knowledge of the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS), SIL funding mechanisms, and the broader WA human services/health landscape. Clearances: Valid (or ability to immediately obtain) NDIS Worker Screening Check, National Police Clearance, and Working with Children Check (WWCC). Preferred Proven track record in a similar growth role within an NDIS registered provider, healthcare provider, or community organisation in Western Australia. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery. Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence. Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals. Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities. Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software. Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles. Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges. Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms. Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently. Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
