items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Germany Munich Als Head of Lead Generation verantwortest du den Aufbau, die Performance und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Leadgenerierung. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Cold Calling. Du bringst fundierte praktische Erfahrung aus der telefonischen Kaltakquise mit, weißt, wie erfolgreiche Outbound-Prozesse funktionieren, und kannst dieses Wissen an ein Team weitergeben. Du bist sowohl operativ als auch strategisch tätig: Du führst und trainierst unsere Cold Caller, optimierst Prozesse und erschließt bei Bedarf weitere Kanäle zur Leadgenerierung. Dabei bist du technisch affin, prozessverliebt und nutzt gerne technische Lösungen und KI-Tools, um unsere Leadgenerierung smarter und effizienter zu gestalten. Tools wie Zapier, Claude Code, Enrichment Tools wie Lusha und Co sollten dir bekannt sein! Aufgaben Operatives Cold Calling: Du kontaktierst potenzielle B2B-Kunden telefonisch, qualifizierst Leads und vereinbarst Termine für unser Sales-Team Teamführung und Training: Du führst unser Cold-Calling-Team, schulst neue Mitarbeitende und coachst das Team, um die Gesprächsqualität und Performance kontinuierlich zu verbessern Strategische Leadgenerierung: Du entwickelst unsere Leadgen-Strategie weiter, definierst Ziele und optimierst bestehende Prozesse. Weitere Outbound-Kanäle: Du steuerst und entwickelst zusätzliche Kanäle wie LinkedIn-Outreach, Cold Mailing und Paid Ads Performance-Management: Du analysierst KPIs, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und sorgst für die Erreichung individueller und gemeinsamer Ziele Prozessoptimierung: Du entwickelst Leitfäden, Standards und Best Practices für eine effiziente und skalierbare Leadgenerierung und nutzt Technologie, KI und Automatisierung, um unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich zu optimieren Qualifikation Was du dafür mitbringen musst: Mindestens 1 Jahr praktische Cold-Calling-Erfahrung Erfahrung in der B2B-Neukundengewinnung Erfahrung in der Führung und im Training von Vertriebsteams Du bist technisch affin, prozessverliebt und bringst Erfahrung mit KI-Tools mit und hast Lust, diese gezielt im Vertrieb einzusetzen Idealerweise Erfahrung mit weiteren Outbound-Kanälen Strategisches Denken und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität Benefits Betriebliche Weiterbildung Flexible Arbeitszeiten 100 % Remote - Arbeite von überall! items.description: Product Headquarters: Burlington, MA OR US Remote Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode! Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment. Learn more at www.veracode.com , on the Veracode blog , and on LinkedIn and Twitter . We are looking for a motivated Performance Test Engineer with 3–5 years of experience to join our Quality Engineering team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in performance testing, scripting, and analyzing application performance. You will work closely with Performance Engineers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to identify performance bottlenecks, validate application scalability, and ensure our products meet performance and reliability expectations. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, execute, and maintain performance test scripts using tools such as Apache JMeter, Locust, and K6 . Conduct load, stress, scalability, and endurance testing for APIs and web applications. Execute weekly release performance tests , analyze results, identify regressions, and report findings to ensure release readiness. Analyze performance test results to identify bottlenecks, response-time degradation, and resource utilization issues. Monitor application and infrastructure metrics, including CPU, memory, throughput, latency, and error rates. Collaborate with development teams to investigate performance issues and validate fixes. Develop and maintain reusable performance testing scripts and test data. Participate in integrating performance tests into CI/CD pipelines. Document test scenarios, execution results, and performance findings. Support performance regression testing as part of regular release cycles. Work with senior engineers to improve performance testing frameworks and processes. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of experience in software testing, including hands-on performance testing experience. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Practical experience with Apache JMeter or similar performance testing tools. Good understanding of performance testing concepts, including load testing, stress testing, throughput, latency, and concurrency. Experience testing REST APIs and understanding HTTP/HTTPS protocols. Basic programming or scripting experience with Python, Java, or JavaScript. Ability to analyze performance results and troubleshoot application issues. Customer Success Management at Expensify Own a portfolio of our mid-market and enterprise customers, from onboarding through renewal and growth. items.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a “normalized” problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations Germany About the Role We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Account Executives to join our Territory & Commercial Sales Team covering Germany . In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security). As an Account Executive at Cloudflare, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare’s products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives. In line with Cloudflare’s AI-native culture, you will be expected to leverage AI tools actively in your daily workflow — from account research and outreach to meeting preparation and pipeline management — using them as a genuine productivity multiplier, not an afterthought. Responsibilities Strategic Revenue Generation: Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments. Expert Pipeline & Forecasting: Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership. AI-Powered Sales Execution: Leverage AI tools as a deliberate and consistent part of how you sell — applying them to account research, personalised outreach, executive meeting preparation, pipeline analysis, and follow-up drafting. Demonstrate the same AI-native mindset Cloudflare brings to its products in how you manage your own territory and time. Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding: Develop a profound understanding of customers’ IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions. Multi-Engagement Leadership: Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare’s platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives. Virtual Team Leadership: Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery. Digital Transformation Authority: Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations. Compelling Value Creation: Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare’s services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the “why,” communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders. Advanced Negotiation & Closure: Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities. Trusted Advisor & Coach: Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization. Organizational Impact & Leadership: Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience 2+ years of advanced experience selling complex technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model , with a significant track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets. Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security, and Edge Computing technologies , with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments (e.g., SMBs, enterprise, vertical markets). Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales. Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams (e.g., Customer Engineers, Product Managers, Legal) to drive complex deals to closure. Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills , with a focus on articulating the “why” and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers (C-level minus one). Demonstrated use of AI tools in a sales context — account intelligence, outreach personalisation, pipeline management, or meeting preparation. You can speak specifically to how AI has made you faster, sharper, or more effective in a previous role. Advanced negotiation skills with a track record of closing large, complex, six-figure and multi-million dollar deals. Expert-level sales acumen: unparalleled proficiency in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and expansion strategies within enterprise accounts. Authority on digital transformation trends and their impact on enterprise customers, with the ability to position Cloudflare as a key enabler of strategic business outcomes. Strong coaching and mentorship abilities , with a passion for helping colleagues grow and improve. Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and resilient , thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a consistent focus on long-term goals. Proficiency in advanced sales and business intelligence platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite, MEDDPICC framework application). Bachelor’s degree preferred , with a technical background (e.g., engineering, computer science, MIS) highly preferred. Ability to travel as required to engage with key customers and internal teams. Language Skills: German & English Compensation For Germany based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €124,000 - €171,000. This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan. Equity: This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person’s, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer. Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

items.title: Software Engineer - App Stores
items.summary: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets.
items.description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and Web Services at scale. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical , a growing international software company. Canonical 's Store team develops and operates a large system of backend services that power the Snap Store and marketplaces. Our services are built primarily in Python, with a bit of Golang. We have some exciting challenges ahead including continuing to scale our production architecture, significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through the system powering our marketplaces, and enhancing our offering for the booming world of IoT and for large Enterprise solutions. If you have a passion for clean APIs, have a bias towards shipping, and believe that automated tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in. What you’ll do Collaborate remotely with a globally distributed team. Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang). Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale. Review code and technical designs produced by other engineers. Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions. Work remotely with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events. Who you are You have demonstrated professional proficiency in developing public-facing APIs and web applications using Python. You have a broad technology base but favour backend code and infrastructure. You know your way around relational and non-relational databases and can effectively design data models that perform well, and tune queries to access them. You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform. You have demonstrated strong academic performance in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree. You love technology and working with a diverse set of talented people. You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable. You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated. About Canonical Canonical is a growing, international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu -- the world’s #1 cloud operating system. Our mission is to realise the potential of free software in the lives of individuals and organisations. Our services are helping businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu. Canonical is a unique tech company - global, remote-first, open source, with 700 professionals across 50 countries - we want to be the world’s best, not biggest, global software company. With almost every team remote by default, Canonical sets the pace on the 21st-century digital workplace. What Canonical offers: Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #stack Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: 🌍 Finance Research Expert, Remote- Contract
items.summary: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: • Equity Research • FP&A • Corporate Finance • Accounting or Audit • Investor Relations • Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: • Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours • Location: Remote, worldwide • You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP • Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: • You will work on questions about real US public companies.
items.description: Role Title: Finance Research Expert Role Type: Contract Location: Remote Required Skills: Equity Research FP&A Corporate Finance Accounting or Audit Investor Relations Credit Analysis Opportunity Snapshot: Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours Location: Remote, worldwide You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer Scope of Work: You will work on questions about real US public companies. Each question points to information that sits in long filings or IR materials, or that requires comparing several of them to find the right answer. Write questions that require finding a specific figure in a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement, earnings release or investor presentation. Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported). Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version. Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly. Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer. What we’re looking for: Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds: Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies. Investment banking or corporate development. (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures. Credit or restructuring analysis, with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings. SEC reporting or audit. (Big 4 audit, corporate reporting), with experience in restatements, footnotes and how figures change across filings. Corporate law or due diligence. (Securities law, KYC, investigations), with experience tracing entities, executives and related parties across records. You should also be comfortable reading long filings, including footnotes and tables, and have clear written English. How the selection process works: Apply with your resume and a short profile. Complete the finance interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. You don’t need to prepare or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward. Review. We check your experience against what the project needs. Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue. Originally posted on Himalayas

We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot. About the role At Typeform, we believe technology should make work simpler, smarter and more human. We're looking for a Senior IT Engineer to help shape the future of IT at Typeform. Someone who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for automation, AI and building better ways of working. This isn't just about keeping systems running. It's about rethinking how IT operates. You'll play a key role in building an AI first, service led IT function, improving how we manage internal technology, support our people and automate everyday processes. Working within a small, high impact team, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, influence our technology roadmap and help us move from reactive support towards smarter, more proactive IT operations. What you'll do Own and improve our IT operations Act as a senior escalation point for complex IT incidents, requests and technical challenges, taking ownership through to resolution. Help maintain secure, reliable and scalable internal technology systems. Apply ITIL best practices across incident, change, problem and service management. Improve service performance, documentation, operational processes and the overall employee experience. Work closely with the wider IT team to balance daily support with longer term engineering projects. Build smarter systems through AI and automation Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflows across IT. Design and implement AI powered solutions that improve service delivery, productivity and operational efficiency. Improve employee onboarding, offboarding, access management and software lifecycle processes. Use APIs, integrations, scripting and automation tools to connect systems and remove unnecessary manual work. Explore emerging AI technologies and turn promising ideas into practical solutions, with appropriate security and governance. Think like a product owner Take ownership of specific IT services and capabilities, from identifying problems through to delivering improvements. Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and prioritise improvements based on business impact. Build and maintain clear roadmaps and project backlogs. Measure the success of improvements through service quality, efficiency, reliability and employee experience. Lead technical changes, migrations and improvements with clear communication, risk management and planning. Collaborate across Typeform Partner with Security, People, Finance, Procurement and Engineering to deliver secure and effective technology solutions. Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical colleagues. Share knowledge, improve documentation and support the development of other IT team members. Help create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement and experimentation. What you'll bring Strong experience in corporate IT engineering, systems engineering or IT service management within a modern SaaS or technology company. ITIL certification and practical experience applying ITIL principles across incident, change, problem and service management. Proven experience troubleshooting complex issues across corporate IT systems, identity, access, devices, applications and integrations. Strong hands on experience with modern IT environments, particularly Apple devices, Okta, Google Workspace, Slack and Atlassian. Experience building automation using APIs, scripting, integrations or workflow automation tools. Practical experience using AI to improve IT operations, support processes or internal productivity. Experience improving employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, provisioning and access management. Strong problem solving skills and the ability to take ownership of technical challenges from investigation through to resolution. A product mindset, with experience prioritising improvements, managing stakeholders and delivering measurable outcomes. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams. Nice to have Experience designing AI driven IT workflows or introducing AI into internal service operations. Familiarity with AI agents, intelligent workflow orchestration and knowledge management systems. Experience integrating HR, identity, finance, asset management and IT service platforms. Experience building internal tooling, dashboards or operational reporting. Exposure to security, compliance, endpoint management and IT governance. Experience leading technology migrations or large internal systems improvement projects. *Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team , empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Texas URL: https://kyro.ai Sales Development Representative (SDR) Location: Remote, non-US based, working US Central Time business hours Experience: 1-3 years in a B2B SDR/BDR role Employment type: Full-time Reports to: Product Manager - Growth ABOUT KYRO AI When a major storm knocks out power, utilities race to mobilize crews and get the lights back on. Kyro AI builds the software behind that effort: workforce and contractor management for electric utilities, storm restoration contractors, and aggregators. We are headquartered in Plano, Texas, and were spun off from Think Power Solutions, so we pair long-standing utility expertise with the pace and ownership of a product company. https://kyro.ai/ WHY JOIN KYRO - Work that matters: our platform helps communities get power back after storms and keeps a critical, regulated industry compliant. - A growing product suite: StormShield for storm restoration, Kyro Capital for contractor invoice factoring, KORY (our AI copilot), and contractor onboarding and verification. - Credibility from day one: you sell with the backing of real utility relationships and domain know-how. - Close to leadership: direct access to the CEO and product team, and what you hear from customers shapes the roadmap. - Room to grow: a clear path from SDR to Account Executive. - Flexibility: fully remote team. THE ROLE As an SDR, you are the first conversation most utilities and contractors have with Kyro. You will work two segments with very different buying motions: Utilities (enterprise): You will talk to storm response, emergency management, contractor management, supply chain, and procurement leaders. Cycles are long, involve multiple stakeholders, and are often tied to RFIs/RFPs. A win is a qualified discovery meeting or demo handed to the account team. Contractors (SMB to mid-market): You will talk to owners, operations managers, and storm coordinators at line, vegetation, and restoration contractors. Cycles are shorter, phone-first, and owner-led. A win is a demo held and the contractor signed up and onboarded. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Prospect outbound: research target utilities and contractors, build account lists, and reach decision-makers by phone, email, and LinkedIn. - Own the follow-up: run multi-touch cadences, chase no-shows and stalled conversations, and make sure every lead has a dated next step. - Respond to inbound leads the same business day and qualify them before they go cold. - Qualify with rigor: confirm need, timeline, decision process, budget, and compliance requirements before booking. - Book and confirm demos, send reminders, and hand off with clear notes. - Drive conversions: stay with contractors after the demo until they sign up and start onboarding; keep utility opportunities moving to the next stage. - Keep the CRM clean: log every activity, stage change, and next step. - Feed the product team: share objections, competitor mentions, and feature requests from the field. HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED Success is measured on demos held and the conversions that follow. Activity counts are leading indicators, not the goal. KPIs: demos booked, demos held, demo-to-opportunity rate, conversions (contractors signed up and onboarded; utility opportunities advanced to proposal or pilot), pipeline sourced, speed to lead, follow-up coverage (share of open leads with a dated next step), and outreach activity. Targets are set separately for each segment; utility credit weighs meetings and pipeline more than closed conversions. WHAT YOU BRING - 1-3 years as an SDR or BDR in B2B sales, ideally SaaS, with a record of hitting or beating meeting and demo quotas - Disciplined follow-up across phone, email, and LinkedIn without being reminded - Confident cold calling, including with field-oriented buyers who rarely live in their inbox - Clear, concise written communication - Hands-on experience with a CRM and a sales engagement tool (HubSpot, Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar) - Comfort with metrics: you track your own funnel and know where deals stall - Ability to learn a technical, regulated domain quickly - Self-directed and organized in a fully remote setting - Native English speaker, available during US Central Time business hours NICE TO HAVE - Experience selling into utilities, energy, construction, field services, or regulated industries - Familiarity with storm restoration, line work, vegetation management, or contractor ecosystems - Exposure to both enterprise (long-cycle) and SMB or self-serve sales motions - Experience selling workforce management, compliance, or fintech products - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience COMPENSATION AND PROBATION - Competitive market base plus uncapped commission. Base is paid bi-weekly and commission quarterly. - Accelerators: 1.5x at 101-125% of quota, 2.0x above 125%. - The first six months are probationary, with performance reviews at 3 and 6 months against ramped KPI targets (demos held, conversions, follow-up coverage). - If targets are not met, Kyro may extend the probationary period or end employment. - - Employment remains at-will during and after probation. WHAT WE OFFER - Competitive base and variable pay - A fully remote role - A clear path to Account Executive for SDRs who consistently hit target - Direct exposure to product and leadership at a company shaping how utilities run storm response To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/kyro-ai-sales-development-representative

items.summary: About us Love, Bonito is Southeast Asia’s leading womenswear brand, built with a mission to empower women to find confidence through style. Incorporated in 2010 in Singapore, we’ve since grown from a humble online startup into a multi-channel business with over 20 stores and counting across Asia and a thriving online presence. For the next decade,
items.description: About us Love, Bonito is Southeast Asia’s leading womenswear brand, built with a mission to empower women to find confidence through style. Incorporated in 2010 in Singapore, we’ve since grown from a humble online startup into a multi-channel business with over 20 stores and counting across Asia and a thriving online presence. For the next decade, we are looking to expand through new categories, markets, wholesale partnerships, and brand acquisitions. We are evolving into a next-generation regional consumer group — one that blends heart with performance, and creativity with technology. At our core, we’re a team of builders, dreamers, and doers who believe culture is more than words on a wall — it’s how we show up every day. We move fast, stay curious, and take bold bets on ideas and people we believe in. Here, you’ll find a community that challenges you to grow, trusts you to lead, and celebrates you for being you. Together, we’re shaping the future of Asian brands — from right here in Southeast Asia, to the world. Why join us? At Love, Bonito, you’ll do more than just a job — you’ll help build a movement. We’re creating an organization that’s lean, bold, and full of heart — where every person has the space to make an impact. Here’s what you can expect: Purpose with performance : We’re building a world-class Asian brand that competes globally. We hold ourselves to high standards and operate with purpose, integrity, grit and excellence. Join us if you take customer service excellence seriously and are passionate about creating real impact! Growth that’s real : We are known to be incredibly dynamic and fast-paced. You’ll be expected to learn fast, stretch beyond your comfort zone, and work alongside people who challenge and support you in equal measure. Don’t join us if you’re looking for a comfortable, fully structured setup, but do join us if you’re excited to build, shape, and make an impact together! Culture at our core : If you’re looking for a no-corporate-BS environment, you’ll fit right in. We lead with empathy, celebrate individuality, and believe that great work comes from trust, not titles. We believe in teamwork and effective collaboration - because when we run together, we go further. If this speaks to your values, come join us and be part of #TeamLB! Join us as we redefine what it means to build an enduring global consumer group. About the role As CRM & Martech Senior Associate at Love, Bonito, you are the technical owner of our CRM engine. You build, automate and optimise the lifecycle programmes, data flows and loyalty logic that drive customer retention across six markets. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. It suits someone who would rather build a Canvas, debug a webhook or write a query than sit in a meeting. You will use automation and AI to deliver the output of a much larger team, and you will be accountable for measurable impact on retention, repeat purchase and customer lifetime value. You will report into our Growth & E-commerce lead. Main Responsibilities: Customer engagement platform management and lifecycle automation Build, QA and optimise canvases, triggered journeys and campaigns end to end, including onboarding, browse and cart abandonment, post-purchase, winback and tier movement. Write dynamic content and personalisation logic using templating languages and real-time data feeds, and maintain modular templates across email, push, in-app and SMS/WhatsApp. Design A/B tests and holdout groups so that every programme proves incremental lift. Build scalable multi-market and multi-language templates using Liquid, Braze Catalogues, and Connected Content (including API caching and abort fallbacks). Own email deliverability and channel health, including sunset policies, frequency capping, and WhatsApp template approvals. Data and integrations Build and maintain the segment library using SQL and Braze segmentation. Keep customer data clean, de-duplicated and compliant with PDPA and consent requirements. Work with the Data and Tech teams to scope, test, ship and troubleshoot integrations. Loyalty logic Configure and maintain the tier rules, points, triggers and reward mechanics of LBCommunity Rewards. Model the customer and financial impact of proposed loyalty changes before they go live. Measurement and insight Build automated reporting on retention, repeat rate, CLV, programme incrementality and deliverability. Turn data into specific, prioritised recommendations for regional and country marketing teams. AI and martech innovation Identify and pilot AI tools for content variants, send-time and channel optimisation, predictive churn and next-best-action. Audit the martech stack regularly and recommend what to keep, cut or add. What success looks like in first 6 months Core lifecycle journeys audited, rebuilt where needed A clean Braze data model and a documented segment library that the team uses Loyalty tier logic correctly configured, documented and free of manual workarounds Tight partnership with Data team and critical CRM reports improved Tight partnership with CRM team At least one experimentation that lifts performance At least one automation pilot in production that measurable saves time or lifts performance You should have / be: A genuine love of systems, data and logic. When you see a messy customer journey, you want to rebuild it properly. Rigour. You test before you trust, and you document what you build. An automation-first mindset. You would rather automate a task than repeat it A daily AI user who adopts new tools because they make you faster and better, not because they are new. A self-starter who finds the leak in the funnel, sizes it and fixes it without waiting for a brief. Clear communication with non-technical teams, so that complex logic becomes simple decisions. Lives and breathes our brand values: People Matter, Go Above & Beyond, Be Bold & Creative, Always Keep It Real, We’re Better Together, and Growth Mindset Requirements: 2 to 4 years of experience in CRM, digital marketing with proven track record of building automated lifecycle programmes with measurable retention impact At least 1-2 years of hands-on experience with Braze or a comparable platform such as CleverTap, MoEngage, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Iterable Strong SQL. Comfortable working with data models, APIs, webhooks and JSON Experience with BI tools i.e. Tableau, Metabase, Looker Proficiency in HTML, CSS and SQL 1. Flexible Work Arrangement Hybrid, work from anywhere! Flexible work hours 2. Staff Wellness Comprehensive corporate insurance (Fully covered visits at our panel clinics, dental coverage, maternity reimbursement) 3. Learning and Career Development Learning and development (i.e. subscription plans to best-in-class resources, personal development fund etc) Dedicated leadership training for those of managerial responsibilities Friday pm off for learning 4. #TeamLB perks Generous staff discount off LB products

items.description: Somos redbee, una empresa argentina de tecnología con más de 14 años de experiencia redefiniendo la forma de construir productos digitales en la industria financiera. Nos apasiona co-crear soluciones innovadoras junto a nuestros clientes. Combinamos experiencia, calidad y escalabilidad para desarrollar productos estratégicos y de misión crítica. Nos destaca nuestra obsesión por aportar valor rápido y de calidad. ¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades? Diseñar y liderar la construcción de pipelines de datos, siendo responsable de su calidad y confiabilidad de punta a punta. Definir el modelado y las transformaciones de datos, optimizando performance y costo con criterio de negocio. Administrar y optimizar los recursos de datos en GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Composer, entre otros), tomando decisiones de arquitectura. Diseñar e implementar la estrategia de monitoreo, calidad e integridad de datos (alertas, validaciones, SLAs). Trabajar con Analytics, Producto e Ingeniería para entender necesidades del negocio, proponer soluciones técnicas y priorizar. Documentar arquitecturas y definir estándares de ingeniería de datos para el equipo. Liderar code reviews y acompañar técnicamente (mentoría) a perfiles más junior. ¿Qué esperamos de vos? Más de 5 años de experiencia como Data Engineer o rol similar. Experiencia sólida en Google Cloud Platform (GCP), incluyendo diseño de soluciones. Dominio avanzado de Python. Experiencia en producción con Google BigQuery, incluyendo optimización de costos y consultas. Experiencia diseñando y orquestando pipelines con Apache Airflow. Experiencia con dbt (modelado, tests, documentación) y definición de buenas prácticas. SQL avanzado y modelado de datos. Control de versiones (Git) y trabajo colaborativo en equipos. Inglés intermedio-avanzado. ¿Cuál es nuestra propuesta de valor? En redbee buscamos crear un espacio de trabajo donde las personas se sientan felices y puedan desarrollarse; por eso ofrecemos 10 días hábiles de vacaciones y adicionamos 5 días hábiles más. Trabajamos con flexibilidad y de forma remote-first y, si vivís en AMBA, nos encontramos una vez al mes en la oficina para compartir, charlar y seguir construyendo vínculos. Sí estás fuera de AMBA el trabajo es full remote. Nos interesa tu comodidad, es por eso que contamos con coworks y brindamos equipamiento para tu espacio de trabajo. Además brindamos un monto mensual de puntos para canjear en una plataforma de beneficios. Sabemos que la familia ocupa un lugar importante: ofrecemos prepaga para vos y tu grupo familiar. También otorgamos licencias extendidas para que puedas estar presente en esos momentos que importan. Creemos en el aprendizaje continuo y en el crecimiento a largo plazo. Vas a tener clases de inglés, acceso a plataformas de capacitación y un plan de desarrollo claro, pensado para acompañar tu viaje dentro de redbee. En redbee buscamos dejar huella en las trayectorias profesionales y ser una experiencia memorable en tu carrera. Creemos que la calidad técnica y la humana van de la mano, y desde ahí transformamos realidades a través de la tecnología. Si queres ser parte, ¡queremos conocerte!

items.summary: Headquarters: New York, New York, United States URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/ About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: New York, New York, United States URL: https://sweetspothvac.com/ About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale. About the role We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch. This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend. What you will do Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research. Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency. Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad. Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad. Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named. Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round. Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows. What we are looking for Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them. A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations. Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses. AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how. Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads. Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed. Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here. Pay and structure Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience. Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads. Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales. Our hiring process (exactly how it works) Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow). Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete. Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario. Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more. Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30. We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://impulseuniverse.com Benefits: Bonus based on performance Company parties Flexible schedule About the Event America’s largest Lunar New Year spectacle is back and bolder than ever! Spanning 7 massive halls with over 1,400 vendors, the Asian American Expo brings you the ultimate celebration of mouthwatering Asian street food, nonstop cultural performances, and high-energy excitement. Step into the Year of the Ram, grab your official Red Envelope at the door, and get ready to experience the luckiest weekend of the year! About the Role We are seeking a high-energy, results-obsessed Marketing Contractor to drive direct ticket sales for the Asian American Expo 2027, America’s largest Lunar New Year celebration (7 massive halls, 1,400+ vendors, and hourly cash Red Envelope prize drops taking place January 16–17, 2027 at the Fairplex in Pomona, CA). This is NOT a brand awareness or vanity metrics role. We are looking for a direct-response outreach strategist whose sole focus is converting Southern California local audiences into paying ticket holders through nano/micro-influencers and grassroots digital community channels. Core Responsibilities Nano & Micro-Influencer Acquisition: Identify, pitch, and onboard local SoCal nano/micro-influencers (foodies, lifestyle, family, culture, and local deals) with active, hyper-local followings to promote the Asian American Expo. Grassroots Community Marketing: Actively seat promotional messaging, ticket offers, and event announcements across regional SoCal Facebook groups, local community forums, Nextdoor, Reddit, and cultural community boards. Direct-Response Campaign Execution: Focus messaging around high-converting hooks, specifically highlighting the event scale, food night market, and the "Luckiest Weekend of the Year" Red Envelope cash/prize drops. Weekly Conversion Tracking: Monitor link clicks, promo code redemptions, and ticket conversion rates, optimizing or sunsetting non-performing partnerships weekly. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Primary Metric: Total Event Ticket Sales & Revenue Generated (analyzed on a day by day snapshot compared to last year). Secondary Metric: Number of activated, high-converting local SoCal creators actively posting and driving trackable sales. Qualifications & Requirements Proven Track Record: Demonstrated experience in direct-response marketing, affiliate management, event ticketing, or conversion-focused influencer outreach. SoCal Market Familiarity: Deep understanding of Southern California sub-markets, local food culture, Asian community networks, and regional interest groups (LA, SGV, Orange County, IE). Outreach Hustle: Strong negotiation and persuasion skills to quickly secure high-converting partnerships on lean timelines. Tools: Proficiency with Google Workspace, affiliate/promo tracking tools, Meta/Facebook group networking, and social outreach management. How to Apply Submit your resume along with 1–2 examples of previous campaigns where you directly drove sales or ticket conversions through grassroots outreach or creator partnerships. This is a remote position. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/impulse-universe-inc-asian-american-expo-marketing-local-community-influencer-outreach

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Burlington, MA OR US Remote Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode! Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment. Learn more at www.veracode.com , on the Veracode blog , and on LinkedIn and Twitter . Veracode is seeking a Senior Website Manager to own the strategy, governance, performance, and ongoing evolution of Veracode.com. Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing and working closely with the Creative Director, this role will lead the website roadmap, improve operational excellence, and turn business priorities into high-performing digital experiences that increase traffic, engagement, lead generation, and conversions. You will own the web roadmap, lead the migration from WordPress to Webflow through launch and partner with marketing, creative, demand generation, operations, IT, and agency teams to translate business needs into scalable website experiences. You will oversee site infrastructure, reusable templates, page builds, campaign support, content publishing, and continuous optimization for speed, security, accessibility, SEO, GEO, and user experience. The Senior Website Manager will improve the full digital journey, from organic discovery and campaign landing pages to content engagement, form conversion, personalization, and post-click experiences aligned to priority personas. This role balances strategic ownership with hands-on execution. The Senior Website Manager should be comfortable setting priorities, managing stakeholders, improving governance, and jumping into the details of site updates, QA, analytics, campaign launches, and CMS operations when needed. This is a hands-on role. The manager will build and edit pages in Webflow, troubleshoot tracking and form issues, and review agency work in the code and configuration, not just in screenshots. Key Responsibilities Migration Ownership — Take ownership of Veracode’s in-flight migration from WordPress to Webflow and drive it through launch and post launch stabilization. Align stakeholders, leadership, and agency partners on scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and success criteria. Validate and lead work on content and URL audits, redirect mapping, SEO/GEO/AEO preservation, analytics, integration testing and launch planning. Day-to-Day Site Management — Manage daily website operations, intake, prioritization, page updates, QA, publishing, troubleshooting, and stakeholder requests while maintaining high standards for accuracy, usability, performance, and brand consistency. Data and Analytics — Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, heatmaps, dashboards, and campaign data to monitor traffic, behavior, conversions, attribution, and funnel performance, then translate insights into optimization priorities. Content Governance and Quality Control — Maintain site content standards, taxonomy, metadata, redirects, page ownership, review cycles, archival processes, and content hygiene so the website stays accurate, discoverable, compliant, and easy to maintain. Strategic Roadmap and Vision — Architect and execute web strategies that incorporate AI-enabled personalization, SEO, GEO, campaign performance, content experience, and conversion optimization to drive traffic, engagement, and pipeline impact. Design Strategy & Governance — Lead visual and UX evolution, ensuring designs align with brand identity; manage scalable design systems, wireframes/prototypes (e.g., Figma), and trends like micro-interactions, organic layouts, and performance-driven creativity. Own the translation of Figma designs into Webflow components and templates. Conversion-First UX & AI-Enhanced Personalization — Direct user journeys for high-stakes pages; implement AI-driven adaptive experiences and A/B testing to optimize funnels. Privacy, Consent, Accessibility and Compliance — Partner with legal, security, and marketing operations to manage cookie consent, privacy requirements, data collection standards, accessibility, and compliance needs across website experiences. As a security company, our site is held to a high bar for security hygiene, accessibility and privacy. Performance Optimization — Use Core Web Vitals monitoring, A/B and multivariate testing, heatmaps, and performance insights to balance rich visual experiences with site speed and continuously improve funnel performance. Reporting and Executive Visibility — Establish recurring website performance reporting, dashboards, insights, and recommendations that connect website activity to pipeline, campaign impact, SEO performance, conversion trends, and business priorities. SEO, GEO and Growth Management — Lead technical SEO, GEO, keyword strategy, and content performance to improve organic visibility across traditional and generative search experiences. Technical Oversight — Manage Webflow, WordPress, or similar enterprise CMS environments, and coordinate with IT and development teams on infrastructure, security, bugs, integrations, and new features. Manage WordPress through sunset and Webflow as the long-term platform, including CMS structure, permissions, hosting, and custom code. Website Release Management and QA — Own launch readiness for new pages, templates, campaigns, integrations, and site changes, including requirements intake, testing, stakeholder approvals, rollback planning, documentation, and post-launch monitoring. Cross-Functional Leadership — Partner with marketing, creative, product marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, IT, sales, agencies, and vendors to gather requirements, align priorities, manage dependencies, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver website initiatives on time. Vendor and Agency Partnership — Act as the primary liaison for web development partners and agencies. Scope projects, manage timelines and deliverables, conduct quality reviews, and ensure external teams align with Veracode standards, brand guidelines, accessibility expectations, and strategic objectives. Hold agencies accountable to defined acceptance criteria and evaluate their technical work independently. Marketing Automation Integration — Work with marketing ops to ensure seamless ties with Marketo forms, lead capture, and CRM (Salesforce). This role gathers business, technical, design, campaign, and content requirements to deliver high-performing website experiences. You will administer infrastructure, manage CMS operations, build scalable templates and interactive experiences, publish content, improve governance, and continuously optimize site performance. Required Skills & Qualifications 8–10+ years in web management, digital marketing, or web program management, with strong emphasis on strategy, design oversight, and growth. Experience leading a full CMS migration for a large B2B site (hundreds of pages or more), including redirect mapping, SEO preservation, and tracking validation. Strong experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTM strategies, SEO and GEO tools (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog), and CRO (A/B testing, heatmaps like Hotjar). Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL; frontend literacy (e.g., CSS Grid/Flexbox, animations). Familiarity with website security, ADA/WCAG compliance (accessibility-first design), performance optimization, and 2026 trends like AI personalization and immersive interactivity. Proven project management skills (e.g., Jira, Asana); experience managing agencies, vendors, in-house teams (development/design). Strong analytical mindset; ability to present performance, design, and growth reports to executives. Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration expertise. Experience with Marketo and Salesforce form/CRM integrations. Webflow Enterprise experience is a plus. Examples of A/B Testing Strategies This Role Might Lead Headline/CTA variations on landing pages to boost conversions (e.g., testing benefit-focused vs. feature-focused copy). Layout changes (e.g., grid vs. organic/asymmetric) or visual elements (e.g., hero images/videos, micro-animations) for engagement/time-on-page. Form optimization (e.g., multi-step vs. single-page) or personalization (e.g., AI-segmented content) for lead capture. Button colors/sizes/text or navigation tweaks to improve click-through and funnel progression. Compensation Transparency: The total compensation package includes an anticipated base salary range of $125,000–$140,000, along with comprehensive benefits. The base salary offered to the selected candidate, including the candidate’s position within the salary range, will be determined based on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and other business considerations. The published salary range represents the Company’s good-faith estimate of the compensation range at the time of posting. Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information. Here’s our recruitment promise to you: Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers. Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware. Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at careers@veracode.com before taking any further action. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/veracode-senior-website-manager

items.title: Revenue Cycle Manager
items.summary: About Us We are fixing US healthcare by building an AI-native physical care platform, starting with home health. Home health is a $140B industry with less than $10B in EBITDA â 40% of revenue is spent on pure administrative waste. We automate this work with AI, creating a fundamentally different cost structure compared to incumbents. This lets us rapidly take market share by serving the 30% of patients who go untreated today. By reshaping the cost structure of this industry, we unlock its growth. We've built one of the best AI teams in the world (from Character AI, Scale, Palantir, Citadel, Jane Street) and paired them with a team of healthcare veterans to build a new type of healthcare company: one that delivers care at the speed of an AI company. Our physical care platform already operates with 30pp higher gross margins than traditional home health providers. With our AI advantage, we pay nurses more, remove their admin burden, and unlock the scale economics that have been missing from this fragmented industry. If we served this entire $140B market, instead of $10B in EBITDA, we'd drive $60B. We're starting with home health, then expanding to all delivered care. Our mission is "any care, any where" . Fundamentally, our incentives are aligned with America. Every dollar in revenue we make is two dollars taken out of the healthcare system. If we succeed, so does US healthcare. Role overview Weâre seeking a hands-on Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Manager to lead and support a team of specialists in a home health environment. This manager will stay close to daily operations, monitor team performance, and respond quickly to questions and emerging issues to help the team meet its goals. The role focuses on accounts receivable (AR), helping the team move outstanding claims from follow-up to verified resolution. What Youâll Do Manage and support RCM specialists working across home health revenue cycle workflows. Track attendance and monitor individual and team performance against established KPIs and daily quotas. Review workflow boards throughout the day to spot backlogs, red flags, and specialists at risk of missing their end-of-day quotas. Respond promptly to specialist questions while balancing real-time workflow monitoring and other team needs. Identify process gaps and work with the team to resolve issues affecting daily performance. Apply your home health and Homecare Homebase (HCHB) knowledge to help specialists navigate workflows and resolve operational questions. Accounts receivable and collections Guide specialists and team leads in prioritizing assigned commercial, Medicare, and Medicare Advantage receivables, including aged balances, payer responses, rejections, denials, and upcoming filing or appeal deadlines. Oversee claim follow-up through resolution: verify claim status and payment, investigate collection barriers and underpayments, and guide appropriate corrections, reprocessing, reconsiderations, or appeals under payer-specific requirements. Review and respond to escalations when a specialist cannot determine the next action; surface recurring payer, workflow, or system issues to leadership and coordinate their resolution. Ensure claim activity, supporting evidence, next actions, and follow-up dates are documented accurately in the applicable AR workflow and HCHB. Partner with billing, payment posting, prior authorization, clinical, and other teams to resolve discrepancies, obtain documentation, and follow paid-but-not-posted claims through resolution. Review proposed write-offs for documented collection efforts and supporting evidence, and route them through the required approval and posting process. Quality and team development Review claim work for accurate denial interpretation, appropriate action, complete documentation, timely follow-up, and correct escalation; use findings to coach specialists and strengthen performance. Support onboarding, payer and system cross-training, and regular knowledge sharing. Identify patterns behind collection challenges and update SOPs or workflows to prevent repeat issues. Share frontline feedback on AR dashboards and automation with relevant teams to improve prioritization, visibility, and specialist workflows. Basic Qualifications Strong experience in home health revenue cycle operations. Familiarity with Homecare Homebase (HCHB). Experience managing RCM specialists, including tracking attendance and performance KPIs. Experience monitoring workflows throughout the day and identifying risks to daily productivity targets. Experience identifying collection challenges and implementing processes to resolve. Working knowledge of AR follow-up, denial investigation, appeals or reprocessing, and payer-specific filing requirements. Experience reviewing claim documentation and quality, escalating unresolved issues, and coordinating with billing or posting teams. Ability to respond promptly to team questions while managing multiple priorities. Ability to identify workflow or process gaps and help the team address them. Preferred Qualifications Experience managing distributed or offshore revenue cycle teams. Familiarity with commercial fee-for-service and Medicare or Medicare Advantage home health claims, including episodic/PDGM workflows. Experience with AR dashboards, clearinghouses, and payer portals such as Waystar and Availity. Experience using denial trends, quality reviews, or operational data to improve collections workflows and team training. What We Offer Competitive salary Comprehensive health insurance, dental, and commuter benefits 401(k) retirement plan with employer contribution Opportunity for growth in a fast-growing company Collaborative team valuing innovation and problem-solving Please mention the word **MAJESTY** and tag RMTI4LjI0LjE2My4xMDE= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMTI4LjI0LjE2My4xMDE=). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.title: Technical Account Manager
items.summary: About DEUNA ð§¡ DEUNA is a rapidly growing startup revolutionizing global commerce with ATHIA, our AI-powered orchestration and payments platform that helps large enterprises boost approval rates, reduce costs, and unlock new revenue. Built by the team behind DEUNAâthe fastest-growing Commerce OS in Latin AmericaâATHIA combines payment intelligence, checkout optimization, and data orchestration in one powerful solution. With deep integrations across 300+ PSPs and alternative payment methods, and over 20% of Mexicoâs digital economy running through our platform, we simplify global payments through a single integration and centralized reconciliation. We are a rapidly growing startup expanding into the U.S. to meet the urgent needs of large retailers, marketplaces, airlines, and QSRs. Join us to shape the future of payments! ð Visit https://www.deuna.com/ to learn more about us! About the Role As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will be the primary technical point of contact for our merchants after their initial go-live. You will help monitor merchant technical health, support incident management, answer ongoing technical questions, and guide merchants through future technical evolutions. For DEUNAâs premium and key accounts, the TAM plays a critical role in making sure merchants feel technically protected, proactively monitored, and confident operating on our platform. Your mission is to help ensure every merchant is operationally stable, technically satisfied, and continuously improving on DEUNA. Responsibilities Proactively monitor merchant technical health Monitor merchant performance, transaction behavior, errors, declines, latency, and anomalies.
