items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: Czechia URL: http://bloomreach.com Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey. We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. We're designing the future of autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. Are you looking for a cutting-edge tech stack to work with daily? We are currently expanding our Infrastructure team and are looking for a new colleague to join as a Staff DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer . You can work from home or one of our Central Europe offices (Bratislava, Brno, Prague) on a full-time basis. The base salary range for this position is 1 520 000 - 1 900 000 CZK. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. Are you ready to grow with us? What tech stack do we have for you? Kubernetes (GKE), Terraform, GitLab Google Cloud, including a wide range of managed products such as Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Bigtable, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub Self-hosted stack: MongoDB, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Etcd, Victoria Metrics, InfluxDB, Sentry Python, Golang Minimum requirements: At least 5 years of production experience with: Kubernetes - we are looking for an engineer who not only deploys applications to a cluster, but also understands what is happening behind the scenes and can operate 24x7 production GCP (preferred)/AWS/Azure - our solution is built on top of the GCP platform. Candidate should be comfortable working with public cloud, understand the risks and benefits associated with running applications in the public cloud, be familiar with infrastructure as a code principle, and have the ability to make design choices between using cloud-managed solutions versus self-hosted alternatives Python/Go - you should be able to read and understand code with confidence, and to review and evaluate AI-generated Python code for correctness, security, and fit. Hands-on coding skills matter less than before, but you should still be able to develop custom tooling when needed, with or without AI assistance If you don’t meet these requirements, don’t worry; take a look at the Senior DevOps position - Czechia: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/bloomreach/jobs/8329244 , Slovakia: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/bloomreach/jobs/8329243 How to know if you are a good fit: The qualifications outlined below serve as a guide to determine if your skills and experience align with the requirements of this position: Design and Specification : You turn loosely defined problems into designs and specifications that others can execute. You write design proposals, weigh trade-offs between managed and self-hosted solutions, and review the designs of others. Cross-team Leadership : You have led projects spanning multiple teams, from scoping and planning through delivery, coordinating engineers who do not report to you. Independent Delivery : You take a specified maintenance or project task and drive it to completion on your own. AI assistants are a given part of your toolkit, but you always understand and can explain how and why every change was made. AI as a Tool, Not a Replacement : You use AI assistants to work faster, not to hand your work over. You understand what the AI produced, question and verify it, and steer it toward the outcome you want rather than accepting whatever it gives you. You stay in control and remain accountable for everything you ship. Continuous Learning : You have a keen interest in Kubernetes and related technologies, as demonstrated by your active engagement in reading and staying up to date on them. Conference Participation : You have participated in DevOps-related conferences, showcasing your commitment to continuous learning and networking in the field. Configuration Proficiency : You have hands-on experience configuring pod/container security context, network policies, roles and role bindings, pod affinity, host path, pod disruption budgets, priority classes, node taints, to name a few. Resource Optimization : You have analyzed resource usage of applications hosted on a cluster and implemented or suggested changes to resource requests/limits, Horizontal Pod Autoscalers (HPAs), or Vertical Pod Autoscalers (VPAs). Cluster Management : You have a deep understanding of the clusters you manage, including the types of machines used in node pools, the reasons for their selection, which cluster features are enabled or disabled, the cluster version, and the node autoscaling configuration. You have successfully upgraded the Kubernetes cluster versions without interrupting live applications hosted on the cluster. Terraform Proficiency : You have written a Terraform module with multiple interconnected resources. Monitoring and Alerting : You have experience setting up monitoring systems and configuring alerts. On-duty experience is preferred, along with experience with Grafana and Prometheus. DevOps and CI/CD Experience : You have experience with DevOps, Orchestration/Configuration Management, and Continuous Integration technologies, including Terraform, GitLab, Ansible, and Docker. Team Onboarding and Training : You have experience with onboarding and training new team members, demonstrating your leadership skills and commitment to team growth. About your team: The Infrastructure team operates and maintains Bloomreach Engagement core infrastructure built on Google Cloud with security, high availability, costs, and scalability in mind. Our vision is to identify and implement opportunities to achieve a robust, reliable, and efficient infrastructure and development platform. We strongly support DevOps culture: each team is responsible for releasing, operating, and monitoring their own applications. The role of the Infrastructure Team is to provide a strong foundation upon which all teams can build, for example, manage big infrastructure components like Kubernetes, databases, and cloud components in Google Cloud. An important role of the team is also to provide support to developers, review design proposals, validate the performance and availability of applications, and sometimes even develop new core application components such as logging or authorization. Tasks and responsibilities: In the position of Staff DevOps Engineer, you’d be expected to work with other Engineering teams to design sustainable infrastructure, microservice solutions, and an efficient and robust production environment. Additionally, you’ll be working on a variety of tasks and projects, including automating tools and infrastructure to reduce manual work, monitoring applications and participating in an on-call rotation as required. You’ll own the design and specification of infrastructure initiatives, break them down into tasks the team can execute, and lead projects that span multiple engineering teams. AI assistants are a given part of your toolkit, and you retain full understanding of, and responsibility for, what gets shipped. The ideal candidate will be passionate about learning new things, creative, willing to take the initiative, and able to think outside the box to solve problems strategically. #LI-KP1 More things you'll like about Bloomreach: Culture: A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication. We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style. We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents. We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead. We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*. The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5 Personal Development: We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions. Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.* Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins. Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)* Well-being: The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.* Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.* We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones. We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other. Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.* Compensation: Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.* Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.* We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000! We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!* (*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.) Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences! If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful! Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees. #LI-Remote To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bloomreach-staff-devops-engineer

items.description: Product Headquarters: Hidalgo del Parral, Chihuahua, Mexico URL: https://customer.io About Customer.io Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. About the role Hi, my name is Megan Berry, Senior Director of Product at Customer.io , and I'm looking for a Senior Product Manager to help us turn customer signals into products people actually want. Our team is six product managers who partner closely with Design and Engineering to launch first-class products that drive customer and business outcomes. You need to be able to synthesize customer research, market research, analytics and your own taste into a customer-first roadmap and set of releases. You will work with a cross-functional team with a high level of autonomy to validate ideas early and help the team ship excellent work. This role focuses on Workflows. What we value Surfacing customer problems based on qualitative and quantitative data. Driving alignment through effective communication. Performing market research and presenting findings. Using AI to accelerate discovery. Helping our teams ship sooner. What you’ll do Identify and validate customer problems through user research, usage analytics, partner insights, and AI-powered discovery tools. Rapidly prototype and run focused experiments to test hypotheses and de-risk new ideas early in development. Lead cross-functional planning by aligning Engineering, Design, and business stakeholders around clear product goals and trade-offs. Drive feature strategy and influence roadmaps by proposing initiatives rooted in customer impact and market opportunity. Break down complex projects into incremental, testable releases, using component reuse and system thinking to accelerate delivery. Define product success metrics upfront and track adoption, engagement, and retention to inform iterative improvement. Take on Technology Lead responsibilities for specific initiatives when needed, including data analysis, prototyping, coordinating engineering work, and managing delivery risks. Look at product metrics after launch and work with GTM stakeholders to ensure your launches are successful and create the product and business outcomes we want. What we're looking for 7+ years of product management experience, ideally including time in B2B SaaS or platforms that leverage behavioral data for automation or messaging. Strong analytical skills, comfort with metrics dashboards, and experience using data to shape direction and evaluate impact. Proven ability to lead feature development independently, reduce scope, and deliver successful outcomes with tight teams. High product intuition balanced with humility and experimentation. You're comfortable being wrong and eager to learn quickly. Exceptional written communication and decision-framing abilities, especially in remote and async-first environments. Experience using or developing AI-powered tooling in your product workflow. Technical background with demonstrated ability to build basic web applications, write scripts, and work with engineering teams on topics such as data models, APIs, and performance requirements. Track record of serving as a point of contact or DRI for engineering initiatives, with the ability to choose objectives and navigate trade-offs. Experience with products that involve complex workflows or automations is a plus. Compensation & Benefits We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $170k–$200k USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. Zone 1: $204k–$240k USD Zone 2: $187k–$220k USD Zone 3: $170k–$200k USD We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family . We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO , stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more. See full benefits here → Our Process No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision. 30-minute video call with a Recruiter 30-minute video call with the Hiring Manager 60-minute Engineering working session (Product case, Part 1) 60-minute Product case presentation with the Product team and Hiring Manager (Part 2) All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process. Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact. Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io . Join us! Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read — apply now. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-senior-product-manager-workflows

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: URL: http://cmswa.com Custom Mechanical Solutions delivers energy-efficient HVAC systems across the Pacific Northwest, with deep expertise in healthcare, education, data centers, and retrofit projects. We work with top manufacturers to meet performance and sustainability goals—always focused on quality, care, and progress. If you're ready to grow your career, we’re glad you found us. At CMS, you’ll join a team that supports your development and gives you space to make an impact. We review every application carefully and appreciate your interest in growing your career with our team. About Custom Mechanical Solutions Custom Mechanical Solutions (CMS) provides commercial HVAC equipment and technical solutions for complex building applications. We partner with contractors, engineers, building owners, and manufacturers throughout the equipment lifecycle—from system design and delivery through startup, troubleshooting, and field support. As part of the Meriton family of companies, CMS maintains its specialized technical expertise and customer-focused approach while benefiting from the resources and long-term investment of a growing national organization. Title: Quality & Reliability Engineer Department: CMS National Accounts Location: Fully remote within the United States Travel: Approximately 10–20% domestic and international travel Turn field challenges into better products, stronger processes, and more reliable outcomes. Join a growing National Accounts team where your technical judgment, curiosity, and follow-through will connect the jobsite to the factory and help shape how quality is managed as the business scales. The opportunity CMS is looking for a Quality & Reliability Engineer to own and continuously improve the field-to-factory quality feedback loop for custom commercial and industrial HVAC equipment. You will lead technical investigations, turn incomplete field information into clear problem statements, and keep root-cause and corrective-action work moving through verified closure. This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role. You will work across field operations, project teams, customers, engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and factory quality leaders. Your work will help teams respond faster, create repeatable repairs, reduce recurrence, and apply lessons learned to future projects. Work from where you are. This is a fully remote position that can be based anywhere within the United States. Approximately 10-20% domestic and international travel is expected, including travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico. Travel may be heavier initially while you build relationships with key stakeholders and learn the factory systems. Travel to Mexico is generally expected up to four times per year to support investigations, gather technical evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate corrective actions. What you will own Lead field-to-factory investigations. Coordinate quality issues from initial report through containment, root cause, corrective action, and verified closure. Turn field intelligence into action. Gather the technical evidence needed for faster decisions and translate recurring trends into improvements in design, manufacturing, supplier controls, installation guidance, training, and documentation. Create field-ready solutions. Develop clear, controlled Field Service Bulletins with approved repair steps, safety requirements, acceptance criteria, and closeout evidence. Drive clarity and accountability. Keep owners, milestones, risks, decisions, and overdue actions visible. Remove blockers and escalate high-impact or aging issues when needed. Use data to improve the program. Maintain quality dashboards and reports, identify systemic trends and emerging risks, and provide concise updates to leadership, project teams, customers, and factory partners. Go where the evidence is. Travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico to inspect equipment, support troubleshooting, gather evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate repair effectiveness. You will probably love this role if... When something fails, your first question is “Why?” and you keep digging until the evidence supports the answer. You enjoy both the technical details and the bigger picture, from walking a jobsite and troubleshooting equipment to explaining the path forward clearly. You take ownership without waiting for every step to be laid out, bring the right people together, and keep work moving until the issue is truly closed. You are comfortable influencing across teams, even when you do not directly manage the people involved. You want to help build and improve a quality program, not simply maintain one. Required qualifications A bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or Quality Engineering, or an equivalent combination of technical education and relevant professional experience. At least three years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, field service, commissioning, reliability engineering, technical investigations, or related technical project support. Strong mechanical and/or electrical investigation and troubleshooting skills. Working knowledge of structured problem-solving methods such as RCA, CAPA, 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, or FMEA. Ability to translate incomplete field information into clear technical problem statements and drive corrective actions through verified closure. Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences. Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 10–20%, including travel to manufacturing facilities in Mexico. A valid passport at the time of hire is preferred; candidates without one must be able to obtain one within the first 90 days of employment. Preferred qualifications Five or more years of relevant quality, reliability, field-service, commissioning, or technical investigation experience. Direct experience with commercial or industrial HVAC equipment. Experience with custom air-handling equipment, controls, construction drawings and specifications, startup, commissioning, or active job-site processes. Experience working directly with manufacturing facilities, suppliers, factory quality teams, or field-service organizations. Experience developing technical repair procedures, Field Service Bulletins, corrective-action documentation, or quality dashboards. Compensation and benefits Base salary: $95,000-$125,000 annually, depending on experience. This position is also eligible for a discretionary bonus. Eligible employees may participate in Meriton’s benefits programs in accordance with applicable plan terms. Why CMS National Accounts You will join a fast-moving team supporting complex equipment and significant projects where expectations are high, and the connection between field performance and customer experience matters. This role offers the opportunity to make quality information more complete, corrective actions more durable, repairs more repeatable, and lessons learned more useful across a growing portfolio. If you are ready to solve meaningful technical problems and help build a stronger quality and reliability program, we would like to hear from you. items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond. Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits: Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…) Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals JOB SUMMARY You will own the reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of the PostgreSQL data platform behind our flagship CMS — primarily Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL — along with the infrastructure and automation around it. This is a reliability engineering role, not a classic administration one. Aurora takes care of patching, backups, failover, and storage growth; you own what it does not — query and index strategy, plan regressions across major version upgrades, vacuum and bloat, connection management, zero-downtime schema change, logical replication, and capacity and cost modeling. Alongside this, you work as a full member of the Infrastructure team on Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and security tooling, and you share the on-call rotation. You will work in a shared-ownership model: backend teams own their queries and schemas, and you own the platform, guardrails, tooling, and knowledge-sharing that make their decisions safe. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, DevOps engineers, Security, product owners, and the Data team. We measure success by the reliability and predictable performance of the data platform, the quality of your incident response, and how well other engineering teams are equipped to make sound database decisions without you in the room. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Database platform (approx. 60%) Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our PostgreSQL platform (primarily Amazon Aurora): query and index strategy, execution plans, configuration tuning, and capacity planning, with particular attention to hot multi-tenant read paths. Lead zero-downtime version upgrades and schema migrations at scale, including diagnosing and preventing plan regressions across Aurora major versions. Own the operational health of the platform: vacuum strategy and bloat, long-running transactions and wraparound risk, connection management and pooling (including RDS Proxy), lock contention, and logical replication and slot hygiene. Review schema changes and DDL from backend teams for lock behavior, migration safety, and performance impact, and build the guardrails and tooling that make safe changes to the default path. Own backup, restore, and disaster recovery end-to-end, including rehearsed restore drills and the access, encryption, and auditing controls our compliance obligations require. Model database capacity and cost (I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Serverless v2 sizing, read replica strategy) and drive cost-efficiency without compromising reliability. Infrastructure and automation (approx. 40%) Deliver infrastructure and automation as a full member of the Infrastructure team, using Terraform and cloud-native tooling on AWS, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines including the safe automated handling of database changes. Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability for database and platform systems (e.g. pg_stat_statements, Prometheus exporters, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) so problems surface before customers feel them. Use cloud security and vulnerability management tooling (such as Aikido) to triage findings and keep the team's services compliant. Team, incidents, and collaboration Take part in the on-call rotation, incident response, and postmortems, driving root cause analysis and remediation that prevents recurrence. Raise the database competence of the wider engineering organization through design reviews, documentation and runbooks, and mentoring — so this expertise is not concentrated in one person. Demonstrate AI literacy, leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE; QUALIFICATIONS Required — PostgreSQL depth 7+ years in database engineering, database reliability, infrastructure, or SRE roles, including significant hands-on ownership of production PostgreSQL. Deep PostgreSQL expertise: internals and MVCC, reading and acting on EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), indexing strategy, vacuum behavior, locking, connection pooling, and configuration tuning. Strong experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS-managed database services. Proven track record of zero-downtime upgrades and complex schema migrations on large, busy tables. Hands-on experience with physical and logical replication, partitioning, read scaling, and designing and validating backup and disaster-recovery strategies. Required — Infrastructure and ways of working Solid experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, primarily Terraform, on AWS. Strong Linux fundamentals plus fluency in at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, Ruby, or Go) for automation and tooling. Experience with monitoring and observability tooling, and a solid grasp of security practices (IAM, secrets management, network segmentation). Experience with change, incident, and problem management in production, and with Git and modern CI/CD workflows applied to database changes. Strong written and verbal communication in a remote-first organization, including the ability to explain database trade-offs to backend engineers and non-specialists. Willingness and ability to participate in an on-call rotation. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to have Familiarity with backend frameworks that interact with PostgreSQL (Ruby on Rails preferred; Python, Rust, or Elixir valued). Experience with caching layers (Redis, Memcached) and their interaction with database load. Exposure to analytics pipelines and warehousing (Redshift, Snowflake, ClickHouse) or CDC-based data flows. Experience with container platforms (ECS, EKS, Fargate), NoSQL or vector databases, or AWS certification (Database – Specialty, DevOps Engineer – Professional). MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space GENERAL TERMS Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here . All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ). Here is a sneak peek of Storyblok’s Visual Editor If you need an accommodation for any part of the application process, please email talent.acquisition@storyblok.com To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/storyblok-senior-database-reliability-engineer-i-germany-austria-uk

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Texas, United States, AMER From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role The Enterprise Account Executive will drive towards aggressive new customer and partner revenue goals, while growing our footprint in the Enterprise market. This is a full-time, remote position and must be based out of Texas in the United States. Please note that the compensation listed below does not include commission (uncapped 50/50 split) or RSU value. Accelerate the growth & adoption of Fivetran in the Enterprise Market through value-driven sales cycles. Lead in-depth discovery and demonstrate a deep interest in our Enterprise customers’ data challenges, identify required capabilities and positive business outcomes to drive towards valuable long term customer engagements. Speak comfortably about Fivetran’s vision to a broad range of audiences from C-level executives to individual contributors. Seek out and land deals with new Enterprise target accounts, then look to grow their footprint with Fivetran through new use cases, cross-sells and expansion. Build strategic relationships with partners in order to identify new opportunities and accelerate deal cycles. You thrive in an extremely fast-paced, ever changing work environment. You’re able to keep up with a highly motivated team in a market that is growing extremely fast. You are extremely organized. You are able to juggle lots of things at once while not letting anything drop. You are a strategic thinker. You are able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way. You are a problem solver. You are resilient and creative, able to be resourceful to proactively seek out a solution to a problem. You are enthusiastic! You exhibit passion and excitement for your work and you have a can-do attitude. Previous experience with data integration, database, ETL, or business intelligence technologies is a plus, but not required Please note that the base + uncapped commission compensation listed below does not include RSU value. This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings. As part of our commitment to setting new hires up for success, all new sales team members attend a one-week, in-person Revenue Bootcamp during their second week at Fivetran. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process. items.description: Job Type : Full-time, M-F Location: Hybrid Salary : $105,000-$140,000, annually DOE About the Company Mindful Support Services is a mental health organization dedicated to improving access to quality care by supporting independent therapy and psychiatric private practices. Since 2011, we’ve provided administrative, operational, and business solutions to simplify credentialing, marketing, billing, and patient management for over 2,300 providers serving more than 32,000 patients weekly across 25+ locations and via Telehealth. We are guided by the principles of respect, authenticity, collaboration, and perseverance , and we instill these values into everything we do — from our provider partnerships to our internal team culture. About the Role The Senior Recruiting Manager leads Mindful Therapy Group’s provider recruitment function across multiple markets and is accountable for translating company growth priorities, provider capacity requirements, and market conditions into measurable provider acquisition results. This role owns the operational performance of provider recruitment, including recruiting strategy, team leadership, pipeline health and conversion, sourcing strategy, provider acquisition cost, recruiting investment, forecasting, CRM integrity, performance reporting, and continuous improvement. The Senior Recruiting Manager operates with a high degree of independence and is expected to move beyond managing day-to-day recruiting activity to actively diagnosing provider supply constraints, identifying market opportunities, allocating recruiting resources, and recommending changes in strategy or investment. Success is measured by the quality, predictability, market alignment, capacity impact, and financial efficiency of provider acquisition. This is a senior hands-on leadership role that develops the Recruiting team while remaining close enough to pipeline performance, recruiter execution, market conditions, and high-value provider opportunities to intervene where leadership involvement can materially improve outcomes. Work Environment This position performs work across professional office, remote communication, and provider-facing environments and regularly uses computers, phones, video conferencing, CRM, applicant tracking, reporting, and other standard business systems. The role requires frequent communication with employees, prospective providers, external partners, and company leadership across multiple markets. Local and regional travel and occasional evening or weekend availability may be required to support recruiting events, priority markets, professional networking, team development, and provider acquisition initiatives. Provider Acquisition Strategy & Market Planning Develop and execute multi-market provider recruitment strategies aligned with growth priorities, capacity needs, patient demand, licensure requirements, specialty needs, and market conditions. Translate business objectives into market-specific recruiting plans, sourcing priorities, recruiter assignments, and measurable acquisition goals. Evaluate provider supply, demand, pipeline performance, and market trends to prioritize recruiting resources and identify emerging risks, capacity gaps, and growth opportunities. Balance immediate hiring needs with the development of sustainable long-term provider pipelines and recruiting channels Serve as a strategic recruiting partner to Growth leadership, advising on provider acquisition priorities and market expansion efforts. Recruiting Team Leadership & Development Lead, coach, and develop Business Development Associates and Senior Business Development Associates to achieve provider acquisition goals. Establish clear performance expectations, accountability measures, and development plans related to sourcing, engagement, pipeline management, conversion, forecasting, and professional execution. Conduct regular pipeline reviews, coaching sessions, performance discussions, and career development conversations. Build a high-performing, scalable recruiting organization through standardization, continuous improvement, and leadership development Pipeline & Provider Acquisition Performance Own performance of the provider recruiting funnel from sourcing and engagement through contract execution and successful handoff. Monitor pipeline health, conversion rates, stage progression, aging, loss reasons, and acquisition outcomes to ensure target attainment. Analyze recruiting performance by market, recruiter, source, provider type, specialty, licensure, and modality to identify constraints and opportunities. Support high-priority or complex provider opportunities where senior leadership involvement can improve outcomes Sourcing Strategy & Channel Management Lead sourcing strategy across outbound recruiting, referrals, events, universities, professional associations, networking, paid advertising, and other provider acquisition channels. Evaluate source effectiveness based on provider quality, conversion, acquisition outcomes, and cost efficiency. Expand and optimize recruiting channels, partnerships, and investments to support evolving provider needs and reduce reliance on any single source Recruiting Analytics, Forecasting & Budget Management Develop provider acquisition forecasts using pipeline data, conversion metrics, market conditions, and historical performance. Maintain recruiting dashboards, scorecards, and reporting that measure pipeline health, sourcing effectiveness, acquisition outcomes, costs, and forecast accuracy. Monitor recruiting investments and budgets, recommending adjustments based on acquisition needs, market conditions, and return on investment. Present clear, actionable recommendations regarding recruiting performance, risks, resource allocation, and capacity planning. Recruiting Operations & Process Improvement Own recruiting CRM standards, pipeline integrity, reporting accuracy, workflow design, automation, and data quality Standardize recruiting processes, qualification criteria, communication practices, and pipeline management across the team. Identify operational inefficiencies and implement improvements that enhance recruiting effectiveness, scalability, and provider experience Cross-Functional Partnership Partner with Growth, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Provider Lifecycle, Contracts, Facilities, Front Office, Onboarding, and other stakeholders to align recruiting efforts with organizational priorities. Translate provider capacity needs into actionable recruiting strategies and ensure smooth provider transitions through the recruitment and onboarding process. Represent Mindful Therapy Group at recruiting events, professional associations, industry partnerships, and strategic market initiatives. Provide market intelligence and recruiting insights that inform provider growth, workforce planning, and acquisition strategy. Qualifications: Six or more years of progressive experience in healthcare recruiting, provider recruitment, talent acquisition, business development, consultative sales, or a closely related field. Three or more years of demonstrated people leadership, coaching, or team-management experience. Proven ability to lead a production-oriented recruiting team toward measurable acquisition, conversion, and financial outcomes. Demonstrated experience developing and executing recruiting strategies across multiple markets or provider segments. Experience managing recruiting pipelines, forecasts, sourcing strategies, performance scorecards, and paid acquisition budgets. Strong understanding of provider acquisition cost, recruiting funnel economics, source performance, resource allocation, and return on investment. Demonstrated ability to use market demand, capacity requirements, pipeline performance, and financial information to make recruiting decisions. Strong experience coaching consultative recruiting, provider assessment, objection handling, negotiation, follow-up, and closing. Experience with CRM, ATS, job boards, outbound sourcing, dashboards, and recruiting analytics. Strong analytical, financial, written, verbal, organizational, and cross-functional communication skills. Ability to operate effectively across multiple markets with changing provider needs and business priorities. Experience recruiting mental health or behavioral health professionals is strongly preferred. Knowledge of professional licensure, private-practice environments, and healthcare provider recruitment is preferred. Experience building recruiting processes, training programs, dashboards, scorecards, and operating standards is preferred. Compensation and Benefits: 75% employer covered Health, Dental & Vision benefits plan 401(k) savings plan with employer matching upon eligibility 8 paid holidays 15 PTO days accrued annually in first year Professional and career development opportunities Compensation evaluated with opportunities for advancement Job Type : Full-time, M-F Location: Hybrid Salary : $105,000-$125,000, annually DOE We are an equal opportunity employer with a progressive workplace based on teamwork, integrity, and customer service. We are committed to cultivating the long-term professional potential of our team. Applicants from all fields are encouraged to apply. Background check required. Come join a strong team making an impact in the service world of mental health! It is a conflict of interest for an employee of Mindful Support Services to be a current client of Mindful Therapy Group. We request that individuals who are receiving clinical services at Mindful Therapy Group wait until their care is discontinued before beginning employment.

items.description: Mitek (NASDAQ: MITK) is a global leader in digital & biometric identity authentication, fraud prevention, and mobile deposit solutions. Our verified identity platform and advanced image capture solutions are built on the latest advancements in biometric recognition, artificial intelligence, computer vision and machine learning, and trusted by over 7,500 organizations worldwide. We are headquartered in San Diego, California, with operations in the United Kingdom, Spain, France, Mexico, and the Netherlands. Visit us at www.miteksystems.com. We are Virtual 1st! Whether you choose to work remotely from your home office or in-person from one of Mitek’s offices, our practices, processes and tools are designed to enable your success. At Mitek, the Future of Work is about flexibility and preference wherever and whenever we are working. Because we care about our candidates, employees and customers, we include an in-person meeting as part of our hiring process. It’s one of the ways we live our mission to “Protect What’s Real.” At Mitek, we believe that teams are more resilient, effective, and innovative when they benefit from a wide range of ideas, lived experiences, and perspectives. The strength of our organization is deeply rooted in the people who power it.​ We know that a workforce reflecting the richness of our communities and customers helps us better serve their needs. We are looking for an experienced and passionate Senior Cloud Engineer to join our Cloud Engineering team in the United States. In this role, you will play a key part in designing, operating, and securing the AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure that powers Mitek’s identity and fraud prevention solutions. You will take end-to-end ownership of production cloud environments, drive automation and operational excellence, and help ensure our platforms remain secure, scalable, reliable, and audit-ready. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in a hands-on technical environment, enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, and wants to make an impact on cloud platforms supporting customers around the world. What You Will Do Build and operate cloud infrastructure: Design, manage, and optimize production AWS EKS clusters, including upgrades, autoscaling, networking, and workload security. Drive infrastructure automation: Manage AWS infrastructure using Terraform and infrastructure-as-code best practices to improve scalability, consistency, and reliability. Own deployment pipelines: Build, maintain, and enhance CI/CD and GitOps pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments. Strengthen security and compliance: Implement security best practices, including least-privilege IAM, secrets management, image scanning, and network policies. Support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 compliance, audits, and customer security requirements. Improve observability and reliability: Develop and maintain monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting capabilities to proactively identify and resolve issues. Lead operational excellence: Participate in on-call rotations, lead incident response, and drive continuous improvement through blameless postmortems. Collaborate across teams: Partner with software engineers and other technical stakeholders to improve architecture, system performance, security, and reliability. Share knowledge: Mentor fellow engineers, contribute technical expertise, and help strengthen engineering practices across the team. What You Bring A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. Typically 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or similar roles. Strong hands-on production experience with AWS, including VPC, IAM, EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, and CloudWatch. Deep knowledge of Kubernetes in production environments, including Helm, cluster management, and upgrades. Strong experience with Terraform or equivalent infrastructure-as-code technologies. Solid understanding of cloud security principles, including IAM, encryption, secrets management, and vulnerability management. Proficiency in scripting or automation using Python, Go, or Bash. Strong Linux administration and networking knowledge, including DNS, TCP/IP, TLS, and load balancing. Experience using AI-powered coding assistants and agents to accelerate infrastructure development, combined with the ability to critically evaluate and validate generated solutions. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to engineering teams, auditors, and business stakeholders. A collaborative mindset, strong problem-solving skills, and an interest in mentoring others and sharing knowledge. Nice to Have AWS or Kubernetes certifications, such as CKA, CKS, AWS Solutions Architect, or AWS Security Specialty. Experience with GitOps and CI/CD tools such as ArgoCD, Flux, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins. Familiarity with modern observability solutions, including OpenTelemetry, ClickHouse, HyperDX, or Grafana. Experience with policy-as-code tools such as OPA/Gatekeeper or Kyverno, and container runtime security solutions. Knowledge of additional regulatory and security frameworks, including PCI DSS, HIPAA, or NIST. Experience operating and maintaining databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means building cloud infrastructure that is not only scalable and secure but also reliable, efficient, and easy for engineering teams to operate. You’ll know you’re making an impact when: Our cloud platforms run reliably at scale: AWS and Kubernetes environments are stable, secure, and optimized to support critical production workloads. Automation drives efficiency: Infrastructure provisioning, deployments, and operational processes become more consistent, repeatable, and efficient through Terraform, CI/CD, and GitOps practices. Security and compliance are embedded by design: Cloud infrastructure follows strong security standards, with effective controls and processes supporting ISO 27001 and SOC 2 requirements. Issues are detected and resolved proactively: Improved observability, monitoring, and incident response help minimize disruptions and continuously strengthen platform reliability. Engineering teams can move faster with confidence: Through close collaboration, technical guidance, and reliable cloud infrastructure, you enable teams to deliver and scale solutions effectively. Continuous improvement becomes part of how we work: You contribute new ideas, share knowledge, mentor others, and help advance our cloud engineering capabilities. Why Join Mitek? items.title: Sr. Backend Engineer - Commerce at Taskrabbit
items.summary: About Taskrabbit: Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to-do’s, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more. At Taskrabbit, we want to transform lives one task at a time. As a company we celebrate innovation, inclusion and hard work. Our culture is coll
items.description: About Taskrabbit: Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to-do’s, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more. At Taskrabbit, we want to transform lives one task at a time. As a company we celebrate innovation, inclusion and hard work. Our culture is collaborative, pragmatic, and fast-paced. We’re looking for talented, entrepreneurially minded and data-driven people who also have a passion for helping people do what they love. Together with IKEA, we’re creating more opportunities for people to earn a consistent, meaningful income on their own terms by building lasting relationships with clients in communities around the world. Taskrabbit is a hybrid company with employees distributed across the US and EU and a Built In — Best Places to Work (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) continually ranked across multiple national and regional categories. Join us at Taskrabbit, where your work will be meaningful, your ideas valued, and your potential unleashed! Prior to applying please note: We are currently unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position (including H-1B, OPT, F1, CPT or other employment-based visas). Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. This role is hybrid requiring 2 days in office at our San Francisco hub every Tuesday & Wednesday (located at 130 Sutter St, San Francisco, CA). About the Role The Commerce team is at the heart of Taskrabbit operations, building and maintaining the billing, payment processing, payouts and taxes/fees that make money simple and accessible. We’re seeking a Senior Backend Software Engineer to join our remotely distributed Commerce team. You’ll take ownership of critical financial infrastructure, working independently on complex problems while raising the bar for reliability and code quality across the team. You will: Own and build: Design, develop, and maintain Rails backend payment solutions that integrate with 3rd party providers like Stripe and Sovos, taking full ownership of features from design through production. Drive technical decisions: Contribute to architecture and design discussions for Commerce domains (payments, payouts, billing), addressing tech debt and evolving scalable data models for financial correctness. Strengthen observability : Design, implement, and maintain monitoring and alerting ystems using Datadog, ensuring visibility into system health and enabling proactive issue identification. Champion test-driven development : Write comprehensive, effective RSpec unit and integration tests and hold the team to a high testing bar for financial systems. Solve data problems : Use deep SQL expertise to write queries that uncover payment system discrepancies in Snowflake and improve the performance of slow or legacy queries. Debug and stabilize : Own production debugging for money-flow systems and drive fixes that address root causes, not just symptoms. Mentor and document : Support other engineers through code review and technical guidance, and produce durable documentation of designs and operational insights. Use AI tooling : Apply AI-assisted development practices (spec-driven development, AI coding tools) to accelerate delivery on well-defined specs. Qualifications: 5-7+ years of hands-on professional experience developing with Ruby on Rails, with demonstrated ownership of non-trivial systems or features. Strong SQL proficiency, with experience writing complex queries for data analysis, discrepancy resolution, and performance improvement in production environments. Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining observability and monitoring solutions for critical systems (Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana). Mastery in writing comprehensive RSpec unit and integration tests in complex Rails applications. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Hands on Experience with AI tooling to accelerate parts of the development lifecycle Bonus Points Fintech, billing, or e-commerce experience. Experience with async/event-driven systems, including writing Kafka contracts and defining topics. Background in refactoring legacy systems and debugging complex production issues. Experience with accounting or financial reconciliation flows, audits, or compliance-sensitive systems. Compensation & Benefits: At Taskrabbit, our approach to compensation is designed to be competitive, transparent, and equitable. Total compensation consists of base pay + bonus + benefits + perks. The base pay range for this position is $135,000 - $185,000. This range is representative of base pay only, and does not include any other total cash compensation amounts, such as company bonus or benefits. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed above and will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, qualifications, geography, and level. You’ll love working here because: Taskrabbit is a Hybrid Company. We value flexibility and choice but also stay committed to regular in-person connection. The People. You will be surrounded by some of the most talented, supportive, smart, and kind leaders and teams – people you can be proud to work with! The Diverse Culture. We believe that we make better decisions when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. Women make up half of our leadership team and our diversity representation is above that of the tech industry average. The Perks. Taskrabbit offers our employees with employer-paid health insurance and a 401k match with immediate vesting for our US based employees. We offer all of our global employees generous and flexible time off with 2 company-wide closure weeks, Taskrabbit product stipends, wellness + productivity + education stipends, IKEA discounts, reproductive health support, and more. Benefits vary by country of employment. Taskrabbit’s commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: An Active Commitment to Equity within our Company and Platform. We are an inclusive community where all who share our mission and values belong. Our diverse team represents the communities we serve, breaking down systemic barriers, and transforming lives- one action at a time. Taskrabbit is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military/veteran status, or disability status. Taskrabbit is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. Taskrabbit will consider for employment all qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law. AI-Assisted Prescreening Notice [US Based Candidates Only] : As part of our hiring process, we may use artificial intelligence tools to assist with the initial prescreening of applications and responses. This tool does not make hiring decisions — every application and response is reviewed by a member of our recruiting team to determine fit for the role. If you would prefer not to have your application processed using this tool, you may opt out by selecting ‘opt out’ in the application form or by emailing talentacquisition@taskrabbit.com, and your application will be reviewed manually with no impact on your candidacy.

items.title: Marketing Strategy Insights Lead at Fivetran
items.summary: From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to
items.description: From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About the role The Marketing Strategy Insights Lead sits at the intersection of growth strategy, investment planning, and performance analytics. You’ll partner with the office of CMO, marketing leadership, and cross-functional analytics teams to determine where we invest, how we improve performance, and what it will take to achieve our growth targets. You’ll translate business goals and performance insights into clear priorities, resource decisions, and coordinated action across Marketing. This includes shaping pipeline strategy, evaluating investment tradeoffs, and identifying opportunities to improve conversion, velocity, and efficiency across regions, segments, and growth motions. This is a high-visibility leadership role during a period of significant organizational change. We’re looking for someone who brings structure to ambiguity, challenges assumptions with sound business judgment, and drives decisions through to measurable results. You’ll work closely with marketing leaders, Finance, GTM Operations, Technical Marketing Ops, and Central Analytics to connect strategy, investment, and execution. What you’ll do Growth strategy & planning: Translate company growth targets into marketing plans with clear priorities, investment requirements, and performance assumptions. Lead the analytical foundation for annual and quarterly planning, developing scenarios that evaluate growth opportunities, resource needs, and tradeoffs. Own marketing’s pipeline planning models and assumptions, coordinating inputs across regions, segments, channels, and motions. Identify the highest-impact opportunities to improve pipeline generation, conversion, and velocity; partner with functional leaders to turn those opportunities into action. Investment strategy & efficiency: Shape recommendations for allocating resources across programs, channels, regions, and segments based on expected business impact. Evaluate tradeoffs between headcount and program investment, partnering with Finance and marketing leaders to improve resource productivity. Identify where to scale, reduce, or reallocate spend, and measure whether those decisions improve pipeline yield and marketing efficiency. Develop models that connect marketing investment to pipeline and revenue outcomes, making assumptions and uncertainties clear. Program management & accountability: Lead weekly and monthly marketing performance reviews, focusing leadership on the decisions and actions needed to achieve targets. Proactively identify performance risks, diagnose root causes, and align leaders on corrective actions, owners, and timelines. Track actions and assess their impact, adjusting the approach when results fall short. Lead cross-functional initiatives across Marketing, XDR, Sales, Finance, and Analytics, resolving dependencies and escalating decisions when needed. Insights & measurement: Set the strategic analysis agenda around the business questions most consequential to marketing growth and efficiency. Define the metrics, scorecards, and decision tools marketing leaders need to manage performance. Partner with Analytics to deliver scalable reporting and with Marketing Ops to ensure consistent definitions, reliable tracking, and data quality. Translate complex analysis into clear executive narratives that explain what is happening, why it matters, and what action to take. Skills we’re looking for 8+ years experience in marketing strategy, GTM analytics, or business performance within B2B SaaS, with scope and impact consistent with director-level leadership. A demonstrated record of influencing investment decisions and delivering measurable improvements in pipeline, conversion, or marketing efficiency. Experience developing growth plans, pipeline models, investment scenarios, and performance assumptions. Strong business judgment and a clear point of view, with the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders constructively and build alignment around difficult tradeoffs. Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive recommendations through to execution and results. Ability to independently structure ambiguous problems and balance speed with analytical rigor. Deep understanding of B2B SaaS metrics, including pipeline, ARR, conversion, velocity, acquisition costs, and attribution. Hands-on fluency with SQL and BI tools such as Looker, enabling independent investigation and effective partnership with Analytics. Working knowledge of Salesforce and marketing automation platforms such as Marketo. Clear executive communication, with the ability to connect detailed analysis to business decisions. Bonus Skills Experience navigating a merger, organizational integration, or significant GTM transformation. Experience with experiment design, incrementality measurement, predictive modeling, or cohort analysis. Familiarity with the modern data stack, including Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, and Looker. Background in data infrastructure, developer tools, or analytics software. #LI-JC1 #LI-Hybrid The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process. Pay Range $182,608—$228,260 USD Perks and Benefits 100% employer-paid medical insurance * Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. RSU stock grants* Professional development and training opportunities Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities Monthly cell phone stipend Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. * May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information Click here to learn more about Fivetran’s Benefits by Region. We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes. Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here. We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don’t hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form. We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.

items.title: AI Researcher – Multilingual Data
items.summary: About the Role We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains.
items.description: About the Role We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains. You’ll own research and execution around data sourcing, curation, evaluation, and training strategies for multilingual and low-resource languages, with a strong emphasis on publishing high-quality research and translating it into production systems. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to the frontier: balancing papers, prototypes, and real-world impact in a fast-moving startup environment. What You’ll Do Design and execute research on multilingual datasets , including data collection, filtering, deduplication, and quality measurement Develop strategies for low-resource and long-tail languages (sampling, augmentation, curriculum design) Research and improve cross-lingual transfer , alignment, and robustness in large language models Build and maintain evaluation benchmarks for multilingual performance Collaborate with engineers and researchers on training pipelines and model architecture decisions Publish research at top venues (e.g., ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) and contribute to open-source when appropriate Translate research insights into practical improvements in production models What We’re Looking For Strong background in NLP / ML research , with a focus on multilingual or cross-lingual modeling Publication record at respected conferences or journals (ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.) Experience working with large-scale text datasets across multiple languages Solid understanding of: Tokenization and vocabulary design for multilingual models Data quality metrics, filtering, and dataset bias Transfer learning and multilingual representation learning Comfortable prototyping in Python with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, etc.) Ability to operate independently and ship research in a startup pace environment Nice to Have Experience with low-resource languages or non-Latin scripts Open-source contributions in NLP or data tooling Experience training or evaluating large language models Familiarity with multilingual benchmarks (e.g., XTREME, FLORES, TyDi QA) Why Join Us Real ownership over research direction and impact A team that values papers and production Access to meaningful scale: large datasets, modern infrastructure, and fast iteration Competitive compensation and meaningful equity at an early stage Originally posted on Himalayas

Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build produc
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Atlanta; San Francisco; United States (Remote) Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B. We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal. We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people. Upgrade is a fintech company focused on providing affordable and responsible credit to everyday consumers. Our Auto business is growing, and demand generation is how we reach the customers, and partners who power that growth. As a Demand Generation Manager , you will own the day-to-day strategy and execution that drive new business across Auto, spanning paid media, email, content, events, and sales-led campaigns. You will build the campaigns, nurture journeys, and reporting needed to drive measurable pipeline growth and revenue impact. This is a highly visible role for someone who is analytical, comfortable owning cross-functional work end to end, and energized by building and scaling a marketing foundation. You will work in close partnership with Sales, Partnerships, Sales Enablement, and Customer Success, and alongside Lifecycle, Product Marketing, Design, Legal & Compliance, and Data partners, so that acquisition efforts line up with onboarding, engagement, and retention. You will sit at the intersection of growth and marketing execution, working directly with the teams closest to revenue, with real ownership and the ability to shape how Upgrade shows up in the Automotive market. What You’ll Do: Own demand generation strategy for Auto across PPC, email, content, events, and web Refine the GTM, messaging, and value proposition for each business, aligned to ICP and buyer personas Optimize lead acquisition, conversion, and pipeline velocity, and manage and improve MQL quality and performance Partner with Account Executives, Partnerships, and Sales leadership to brainstorm, align on, and launch campaigns, including sales incentives, competitions, and referral programs Refine nurture journeys and build segmentation strategies in HubSpot, Salesforce, and Outreach Lead campaigns end to end (strategy, execution, measurement), defining success metrics and setting a clear reporting cadence Work cross-functionally to move campaigns forward: Design tickets within the sprint cycle, Lifecycle requests, and early Legal, Compliance, and bank review Oversee website strategy and optimization, ensuring alignment with campaign messaging, ICP targeting, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization Build performance dashboards and attribution reporting tied to revenue outcomes, working with Data and Sales Ops partners across Heap, Google Analytics, Salesforce, and Tableau Manage the demand generation budget and track program spend against results Continuously test and optimize campaigns for efficiency and effectiveness Use AI-enabled tools when helpful to streamline content development, summarize insights, and improve workflow efficiency, so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality What We Look For: 5-7+ years of B2B or demand generation marketing experience, ideally within fintech, consumer lending, auto finance focused products. Proven experience leading demand generation and pipeline growth, including paid digital channels such as Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads. Proficiency in Salesforce and HubSpot. Demonstrated skills or projects with claude, chatgpt, co-pilot or any other AI tool. Data-driven mindset with strong analytical skills, including experience with attribution, funnel reporting, and dashboards in Tableau (or a comparable BI tool). Track record of designing and analyzing test-and-learn experiments (e.g., A/B tests) to optimize campaign performance. Strong understanding of integrated marketing strategy, with the ability to translate strategy into clear plans and messaging. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting results and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Self-starter who is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cross-functional workstreams in a fast-paced environment. BA/BS degree in business or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience. Curiosity and adaptability with AI-enabled tools, which are already part of how work gets done across our organization and will continue to expand over time. Nice to Have: Experience with Outreach, Heap, or Google Analytics. Experience partnering with Legal and Compliance on marketing review in a regulated environment. Experience with partner, referral, or sales-incentive programs. Familiarity with website strategy, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization.
