items.title: Content Reviewer - United States
items.summary: We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit. A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform. By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself. Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies. Service Rates The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Qualification path Qualification Process No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process. Basic Requirements • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English • Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States • Active use of Gmail and social media platforms • Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection • Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher) • Access to a personal computer Assessment You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy. About the Role Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including: Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands Skincare and beauty Tech and software Finance and investing Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability Education Home improvement Automobiles and motorcycles Health and wellness Medical and clinical fields Digital marketing SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply. items.description: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing About the Role At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth. Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools . Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns . Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms. Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels. Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines. Availability during U.S. Business Hours . Preferred Qualifications Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) . Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements. Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions. You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements. In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth. Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords. Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels. Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions. Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency. items.title: 3D Spatial Data Expert (AI Community)
items.summary: About the Role: At TELUS Digital, we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality.
items.description: About the Role: At TELUS Digital , we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality. As a 3D Spatial Data Expert , you are the "Mapmaker of the Future." You will join our AI Community as a specialist tasked with identifying and labeling the physical world within 3D datasets, such as LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) and 3D meshes. While our Specialists handle complex physics and urban planning, you are the one who teaches the AI the "alphabet" of space—where a curb ends, where a pedestrian begins, and how a robotic arm perceives a shelf. At TELUS, you are helping to build the data foundation for autonomous vehicles, drones, and the industrial metaverse. What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities): 3D Bounding Box Annotation: Placing precise 3D cubes (bounding boxes) around objects in point-cloud data to help AI identify their size, location, and orientation in space. Semantic Segmentation: "Painting" 3D maps to categorize different surfaces—distinguishing between a drivable road, a sidewalk, and a permanent obstacle. Point-Cloud Cleaning: Reviewing raw sensor data from self-driving cars or robots to remove "noise" (like rain or dust) so the AI sees a clear picture of reality. Simulated Data Validation: Comparing AI-generated 3D environments against real-world captures to ensure the digital version is a faithful "twin" of the physical one. We are proud to have a global team that drives our innovation and success across diverse markets. Our flagship platform, ReelShort, is the #1 vertical streaming app in the U.S., with over 8 million DAU, delivering bite-sized episodic content that keeps viewers hooked. Other standout products include Chapters, where users shape immersive stories across drama, fantasy, and romance, and My Fiction, a platform for consuming and creating serialized romance. We’re proud to be recognized as one of the Global Most Loved Workplaces 2025, reflecting our commitment to innovation, creativity, and an employee-first culture. Position Overview: As an AI-Assisted Story Writer, you will create short, high-hook, pay-per-chapter stories for mobile readers, working hand in hand with external AI and our in-house AI story system. Our system guides every story through a proven pipeline; your job is to steer that process with strong editorial judgment, push every story past "good enough," and turn out titles that readers pay to finish. This is an ROI-driven role. Every story you deliver goes into live testing, and its results (ad performance, reader conversion past the paywall, and return on ad spend) are the main measure of your success. The ideal candidate is a commercial storyteller first: someone who instinctively understands hooks, cliffhangers, revenge payoffs, romance tension, and why a reader taps "unlock" on the next chapter. You are comfortable using AI as a creative partner, you know when to trust it and when to override it, and you are energized rather than intimidated by data. Key Responsibilities: Use AI story system to write complete short stories of roughly 20,000 words, from title and logline through final chapter, delivered on schedule. Develop stories from a wide range of source material, including one-line ideas, trending topics, web novels, user-generated content, and existing hit stories. Approve story direction at each checkpoint: genre track, core reader expectation, paywall placement, and chapter-by-chapter emotional pacing. Edit and polish AI drafts so the final prose is vivid, emotionally specific, consistent in voice, and free of generic or repetitive AI patterns. Write high-impact titles, loglines, opening hooks, and paywall moments designed to drive ad clicks and reader conversion. Review testing results for every story you deliver, utilize retest reports to diagnose what underperformed, and revise promising stories that fall short of targets. Track your own story performance and apply what you learn to each new title. Stay current on trending tropes, hit stories, and reader tastes across short fiction, web novels, and short-form video drama, and bring new story ideas to the team. How Success Is Measured: Test pass rate: the share of your stories that meet or beat performance benchmarks in live testing. Return on ad spend (ROAS): how efficiently your stories turn marketing spend into reader revenue. Reader conversion: how well your opening and paywall turn readers into paying readers. Output and turnaround: consistently delivering finished, test-ready stories on schedule. Revision impact: how much your rewrites improve the results of underperforming stories. Minimum of 2 years of writing experience in commercial fiction, such as serialized fiction, web novels, Wattpad, Kindle Vella, romance publishing, short drama scripts, or a similar medium. A portfolio that shows strong commercial instincts: fast-paced plotting, emotional payoffs, and hooks that keep readers turning pages. Strong command of romance, revenge, family drama, and suspense, including popular tropes and what readers expect from them. Hands-on experience using AI writing tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in a real writing workflow. Excellent editing skills and the judgment to spot and fix flat, clichéd, or illogical AI output. Comfort with a results-driven environment where performance data shapes priorities and compensation. Ability to read and act on basic performance metrics (click-through rate, conversion, ROAS). Comfortable writing young adult and adult romance and drama, which may include sensitive and triggering content. Native or near-native English writing ability for English-speaking Western readers. Strong attention to detail, self-direction, and the ability to manage multiple stories at once under deadline. Flexibility to work across different time zones and communicate clearly in a remote team. Eagerness to learn and thrive in a fast-paced startup environment. Nice to Have: Experience writing for pay-per-chapter apps or short-form video drama platforms. A track record of stories or titles with measurable commercial results (reads, rankings, sales, or conversion). Experience writing ad copy, hooks, or marketing content for fiction. Bachelor's degree in Creative Writing, English, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Compensation: $3,000. This is an independent contractor (1099) position with an initial one-month term. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: http://www.pritchardindustries.com Pritchard Industries is a dynamic and innovative provider of comprehensive facility services, dedicated to enhancing the operational efficiency of our client partners in the industries we serve. With services from facility maintenance and janitorial to landscaping and snow removal, we enable desired outcomes for our clients through consistent service and outstanding people. We are seeking an initiative-taking and experienced Proposal Writer. As the Proposal Writer, you will play a crucial role in crafting compelling proposals that highlight our company's capabilities and expertise to potential clients. Your ability to synthesize complex information, tailor content, and communicate value propositions effectively will directly contribute to our success in securing new business opportunities. This is a 100% remote role but must reside in the central or eastern time zones. Responsibilities: Proposal Development: • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, subject matter experts, and management, to gather necessary information for proposal content. • Translate technical and business information into clear, persuasive, and client-focused language. • Minimum 3 years proposal writing experience Content Creation: • Write and edit proposal content, including executive summaries, project descriptions, methodologies, timelines, budgets, and other relevant sections. • Ensure that proposals are tailored to the specific needs and requirements of each client or project. Strategic Messaging: • Develop a deep understanding of client pain points, objectives, and industry trends to craft persuasive value propositions. • Tailor messaging to highlight the unique benefits our company offers to address client challenges. Formatting and Design: • Create visually appealing and well-organized proposal documents that are consistent with company branding guidelines. • Use graphics, charts, and visuals to enhance the presentation of complex information. Quality Assurance: • Review and proofread proposal content to ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency. • Verify compliance with RFP (Request for Proposal) guidelines and requirements. Research and Analysis: • Conduct research to gather relevant data, statistics, case studies, and market insights to support proposal arguments. • Analyze client needs and competition to formulate effective proposal strategies. Deadline Management: • Prioritize and manage multiple proposal projects simultaneously, adhering to tight deadlines. • Coordinate with team members to ensure timely completion of all proposal components. Knowledge Management: • Maintain a repository of proposal content, templates, case studies, and references for future use. • Continuously update and refine content based on feedback and industry changes. Collaboration and Communication: • Foster open communication with internal stakeholders to gather accurate and up-to-date information. • Participate in meetings and discussions to understand project requirements and client expectations. Qualifications: • Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Marketing, Business, or a related field. • Proven experience as a Proposal Writer or in a similar role. • Experience with facility services industry. • Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills. • Excellent attention to detail and ability to synthesize complex information. • Familiarity with proposal formatting and design best practices. • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). • Ability to work well under pressure and meet strict deadlines. • Strong organizational and project management skills. • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. • Familiarity with proposal software or tools is a plus. Benefits • Salary range: $65,000 - $85,000 based on experience. • 100% Remote in the Central or Eastern Time Zones only. • Paid holidays and vacation time • Health Benefits Package • Ancillary benefits—Life insurance, Long Term Disability, FSA, and Dependent Spending care • 401K • Opportunity for growth Pritchard Industries participates in E-Verify. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pritchard-industries-proposal-writer

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Australia URL: https://zandahealth.com/eu/ Paid Media Coordinator Are you someone who loves building relationships, spotting new opportunities, and bringing great ideas to life? We're looking for a Paid Media Coordinator to help grow Zanda's reach and connect more health professionals with the tools they need to run successful practices. In this hands-on role, you'll manage our advertising, sponsorship, and association partnerships across international markets. From discovering new opportunities to promote Zanda and negotiating great deals to coordinating the deliverables and measuring their impact, you'll play an important part in how we grow. You'll work within our Marketing team while having the autonomy to make things happen. What You’ll Be Doing Build and own relationships with associations, publishers, media partners, agencies, and vendors across our key international markets. Identify and pursue new opportunities for advertising, sponsorships, and partnerships that increase Zanda's brand awareness and reach. Evaluate and negotiate advertising opportunities, securing competitive rates, valuable placements, and partnerships that deliver results. Coordinate campaigns from start to finish, working with internal teams and external partners to keep creative assets, approvals, tracking, and deadlines on track. Manage Programmatic Advertising across channels such as Paid Social and Display, and support opportunities in Paid Search and emerging advertising platforms. Manage campaign operations, including advertising calendars, budgets, pipelines, and vendor coordination. Track and evaluate performance, using campaign data and insights to identify what's working, recommend improvements, and maximize the value of our advertising investments. What You’ll Bring to the Team 2-3+ years of relevant experience in marketing, media, partnerships, sponsorships, or campaign management. Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with external partners, vendors, agencies, or stakeholders. Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the confidence to explore opportunities, discuss terms, and secure mutually beneficial outcomes. Experience coordinating campaigns or partnerships end-to-end, balancing multiple stakeholders, deliverables, and deadlines. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities independently. A good understanding of campaign performance and the ability to use data to evaluate results and make practical recommendations, alongside experience supporting creative briefs, advertising copy, or landing-page improvements. Bonus Points If You Have: Experience working with professional associations, publishers, sponsorships, or media partnerships across international markets. Familiarity with Paid Social, Display, Paid Search, or emerging advertising channels. Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Google Analytics, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or project management platforms. An understanding of marketing metrics such as CAC, CPA, ROAS, attribution, or UTM tracking. Experience in SaaS, HealthTech, or using AI and automation tools to improve marketing workflows. Who You Are A natural relationship builder. You enjoy connecting with people, creating genuine partnerships, and aren't afraid to negotiate or ask for a better deal. Proactive and resourceful. You spot opportunities, take initiative, and find ways to move things forward without waiting to be asked. Organized and detail-oriented. You can juggle multiple moving pieces while keeping track of the small details that make a big difference. Someone who takes ownership. You're comfortable making decisions, following through on commitments, and being accountable for outcomes. Adaptable and collaborative. You enjoy working with different people, navigating changing priorities and company direction, and finding solutions along the way. Why You’ll Love Working With Us ✅ Work from Anywhere We’ve been a fully distributed team from the start - no offices, no commute, just great people from all over the world doing meaningful work together. ✅ Flexibility & Autonomy We care about outcomes, not clock-watching. Outside of agreed core hours that align to your role, your time is yours - whether that’s doing the school run or squeezing in a midday gym class. ✅ Generous Paid Time Off Balance matters. We offer paid time off and expect you to take it - because rest fuels great work. ✅ High Trust, Results Driven We strip away red tape so you can focus on impact. No pointless meetings or rigid hierarchies - just space to move fast, solve problems, and make a difference. ✅ Growth & Innovation You’ll be encouraged to experiment, stretch your skills, and bring YOUR bold ideas to the table. Everyone at Zanda contributes to shaping what’s next. ✅ Inspiring Teammates You’ll work alongside passionate, curious people who support and cheer each other on - even across time zones. Collaboration is how we win. ✅ Meaningful Impact Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients. Your work will directly improve lives. ✅ Competitive Pay We hire the best people - wherever they are - and we make sure they feel valued and well-rewarded for the work they do. About Zanda Zanda is a fast-growing, globally loved practice management platform that helps health professionals run smooth, efficient practices - and spend more time caring for their patients. We’re used by thousands of clinics across Australia, New Zealand, the UK, the US, and Canada, and we’re just getting started. Our mission is simple: make health practice management easy and enjoyable. To do that, we need brilliant, passionate people who are excited by innovation, love solving complex problems, and thrive in fast-moving environments. At Zanda, you’ll join a globally distributed team that’s small enough to move fast and think big - and driven enough to deliver work that makes a real impact. We live our values every day: Growth: We stretch ourselves, learn constantly, and support each other’s development. Reliability: We follow through on our commitments and show up for our team and customers. Impact: Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients. Teamwork: We win together - celebrating wins, sharing ideas, and having each other’s backs. Zanda collects and processes your personal data for the purposes of managing employment candidate application and recruitment-related activities as well as for organisational planning purposes, for further detail, please refer to the Zanda Health Privacy Policy . This is an exciting time to join Zanda. We’re self-funded, scaling quickly, and building something that truly changes lives. If you’re ready to grow your career while making a meaningful difference - we’d love to hear from you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/zanda-health-marketing-coordinator-paid-media

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote URL: http://onthegosystems.com At OnTheGoSystems , the company behind WPML , Toolset , and PTC , we’re looking for an experienced Head of Content and Editorial who knows what makes content great and can take ownership of content quality and performance. AI is a core part of how we work . AI can already produce content quickly and efficiently. What we need is someone with the experience, strong editorial judgment, and intuition to turn AI-generated content into high-quality, valuable content that resonates with our readers and delivers real business results. We’re looking for someone who has experience working with a small team of skilled writers, setting high editorial standards, and making content successful. You should know what good writing looks like, understand why certain content works, and be able to improve it. What You’ll Work On Content strategy and editorial direction – identify what content we should create, for whom, and why. Content quality and editing – review, improve, and refine content to make it clear, engaging, accurate, and valuable. AI-assisted content creation – use AI tools and workflows to produce high-quality content efficiently while maintaining strong editorial standards. Content performance – track results, understand what makes content successful, and use data to improve it. Content experiments – test new ideas, formats, and approaches, learn from failures, and build on what works. Collaboration with marketing and product teams – understand our products, customers, and business goals to make sure our content supports them. What We’re Looking For You’ve managed small teams of skilled writers and know how to improve and maintain high content quality. You have excellent editing and copywriting skills. You can easily spot what works in content and what needs improvement. You know how to use AI effectively to create and edit content. You’re comfortable working with metrics and taking responsibility for content performance. You use data to understand what works and what doesn't. You have strong editorial intuition built through years of experience. You’re comfortable trying new ideas, making decisions, and checking the results. You’re curious and want to understand our products, customers, and business. You’re hands-on and independent. You can take ownership of your work without detailed instructions. You have experience with technology, software, SaaS, or technical content. We are especially interested in people who have spent years working in high-quality editorial environments, where great writing, strong editorial judgment, and measurable results are essential. We’re not looking for someone whose main experience is managing large volumes of low-quality content. We want someone who knows how to make good content exceptional. Why Join Us OnTheGoSystems is a profitable, self-funded product company growing since 2007 . WPML powers more than 1.5 million websites worldwide . You’ll have real ownership of our editorial direction, work closely with our CEO, marketing, and product teams, and help shape how we create high-quality content with AI. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, make decisions, and see the impact of your work through real results. We care about the people we work with and want to support them beyond their day-to-day work. Along with the flexibility of working remotely, we offer perks and benefits that support both work and life. If you have years of editorial experience, love great writing, and are excited about shaping the future of content with AI, we’d love to hear from you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-head-of-content-and-editorial

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote About the Team: Netlify’s Data team helps the company understand and improve the full product-led growth journey, from activation and engagement through conversion, retention, and monetization. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to uncover opportunities, evaluate investments, and understand what drives customer and business outcomes. We’re hiring a Senior Staff Data Scientist to deepen how data shapes our product and growth strategy. You’ll develop an end-to-end understanding of the PLG journey, proactively identify opportunities, and turn complex data into hypotheses, experiments, and recommendations that influence where we invest and what we build. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who can move from identifying an important question to shaping the approach, defining success, and driving toward an answer. What You'll Do: Own the analytical understanding of Netlify’s PLG performance across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention, identifying opportunities before they become requests Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to turn behavioral insights into product bets, defining what to test, how to measure it, and what the results mean Lead experimentation from hypothesis through decision, including study design, methodology, success metrics, guardrails, analysis, and recommendations Apply statistical rigor where it matters while recognizing when there is enough signal to make a decision and move forward, and help teams develop that same judgment Build scalable analytical systems like semantic models, trusted metrics, proactive monitoring, and AI-powered agents that surface opportunities without waiting to be asked Use AI to investigate faster, automate recurring analytical work, and test more hypotheses without sacrificing the judgment that makes the output useful Identify gaps in measurement, event instrumentation, and metric definitions, and partner with Data and Product Engineering to close them Serve as a trusted analytical partner to PLG leadership, using evidence and product judgment to influence investment decisions and roadmap priorities Influence product strategy through evidence, product instincts, and a clear point of view, without relying on formal authority to do it What You'll Bring: 8+ years of experience in product analytics, growth analytics, or data science, with a track record of high ownership and measurable impact on PLG or consumer product outcomes Deep understanding of product and growth dynamics across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention Demonstrated ability to turn behavioral data into product hypotheses and carry them from insight through experimentation and measured outcomes Deep experimentation expertise: study design, statistical reasoning, causal inference, and the judgment to know when an experiment has told you what you need to know Experience building analytical systems such as metrics layers, monitoring frameworks, or semantic models that teams can rely on over time An AI-native approach to analysis: you use AI tools actively to accelerate investigation, automate repetitive work, and surface patterns faster A track record of influencing senior stakeholders and product direction through analytical reasoning, clear recommendations, and sound judgment Comfort operating with significant autonomy in ambiguous problem spaces, including determining which questions are most important to answer Strong written and verbal communication skills in distributed environments, with the ability to make complex findings clear and recommendations actionable This Role is a Great Fit If: You're energized by finding the opportunity before anyone thought to ask - proactive discovery is how you naturally work, not a mode you shift into You think like a product person who happens to be exceptionally rigorous with data, not a data person who occasionally weighs in on product You thrive when the problem isn't handed to you - you'd rather define the question worth asking than answer the one that landed in your queue You get excited about building systems that keep working after you've moved on to the next problem You're comfortable making a call with imperfect information and can articulate clearly why you made it You enjoy being a thought partner to senior leaders - shaping how they think about investment and opportunity, not just supporting decisions already made You work well in a remote-first, async environment where written clarity and self-direction matter more than proximity You're drawn to roles where the measure of success is outcomes, decisions made, bets tested, metrics moved, not volume of output produced Applying Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway! When applying please include: A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts. Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com . About Netlify Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable. We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’re excited to connect with you! At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify’s equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $204,000 - $275,000 for most US-based locations. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/netlify-senior-staff-data-scientist

items.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a “normalized” problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Austin, Texas | Lisbon, Portugal About The Department Cloudflare’s Infrastructure group is responsible for building our global network. Our Hardware Engineering team helps research, develop, test, and deploy new equipment enabling 20% of the world’s internet traffic to be served smoothly. Deployd across 330 cities in 120+ countries, the hardware we select helps improve the security, reliability, and performance of the Internet. About the Role We need to make thoughtful infrastructure choices affecting a significant portion of the Internet. Hardware we work with includes servers, routers, switches, optical equipment, power distribution units, cables, optics, and more. As a Hardware Systems Engineer, you will work with colleagues on the Hardware Engineering, Product teams, and Hardware Sourcing teams to troubleshoot and maintain Cloudflare’s worldwide fleet of storage and compute servers. What you’ll do What You’ll Do Develop and maintain automation tools to update firmware on servers and components in Cloudflare’s fleet Work with software teams to validate bug fixes and performance of new firmware revisions Test and deploy firmware updates to the fleet, monitoring the progress of the rollout for compliance and reliability Work with server and component vendors to obtain, debug, and maintain the latest updates Work with our Site Reliability Engineering teams to triage bug reports Support our Data Centre Engineering teams in resolving hardware issues Communicate your results and updates through blog posts, internal talks, and tickets Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science Desire to learn about the Cloudflare hardware used by almost 20% of all web sites Desire to learn how a diverse server fleet is managed at scale Desire to learn the tools Cloudflare uses to maintain and monitor our hardware Knowledge of PXE booting Knowledge of configuration management, in particular we use salt to manage our fleet Knowledge of Redfish, IPMI and server remote management protocols Knowledge of running production mission critical systems Bonus Points Familiarity with server hardware architecture Knowledge of debugging server hardware faults and the ability to engage with our sourcing team and vendors to improve quality Experience of managing large fleets comprising of thousands of servers Experience of observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, and the ability to observe trends over time Experience scripting and programming, in particular python and bash Experience with software development tools and processes such as git, Bitbucket and TeamCity and Jira Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. For Lisbon based hires: Estimated annual salary of €54,000 - 68,000 Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person’s, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer. Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. items.description: Job Title: E-commerce Data & Catalog Specialist Job Type: Contractor Location: Remote Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Key Responsibilities: Manage, structure, and curate large-scale e-commerce product catalogs, ensuring data accuracy and consistency across platforms. Develop, implement, and refine product taxonomy frameworks to simulate real-world e-commerce classifications and browsing experiences. Normalize and map product data sourced from diverse databases, applying best practices in structured dataset management. Create and model realistic shopping scenarios that reflect authentic consumer behavior and decision-making processes. Collaborate with AI development teams to define data needs and optimize catalog structures for scalable AI training. Ensure strict adherence to data quality, integrity, and normalization standards within SQL and NoSQL environments. Document workflows, taxonomies, and metadata structures with clear, concise written communication. Required Skills and Qualifications: Demonstrated experience in product catalog management and e-commerce merchandising operations. Proficiency with SQL and NoSQL database concepts, schema design, and product data modeling. Strong command of product taxonomy development, categorization, and data normalization methods. Deep understanding of structured dataset management, including large and complex e-commerce catalogs. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes and communicate technical concepts clearly. Experience building data-driven shopping experiences and simulating consumer journeys. High attention to detail and a collaborative mindset for working with cross-functional teams. Preferred Qualifications: Previous involvement with AI, machine learning, or data annotation projects. Experience with scalable catalog schema design for diverse online marketplaces. Background in creating advanced metadata structures or contributing to AI training initiatives. Additional Info: This is an AI training-focused role. You'll play a key part in constructing realistic, data-rich e-commerce environments to improve AI model understanding and performance. Join our customer's team to help shape the future of intelligent shopping experiences. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a “normalized” problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. About the department Cloudflare’s Engineering Team builds and runs the software that handles trillions of requests per month. Product development covers both new features and functionality and scaling our existing software to meet the challenges of a massively growing customer base. The Cloudflare Zero Trust group within the Engineering organization is taking on the mission of ensuring the people and teams within an organization can access the tools they need to do their job safe from malware and other online threats with the speed and reliability that Cloudflare is known for. What you’ll do In this role, you’ll help us build Cloudflare’s Data Loss Prevention (DLP) product that helps customers of any size protect the data that powers their business. Whether credit card numbers, health records, trade secrets or other types of data, Cloudflare’s solution allows organizations to focus on their business and stop worrying about applying bandaids to protect their data. The solution runs in-line with Secure Web Gateway, Cloud Access Security Broker and Remote Browser Isolation - layering Zero Trust access control and web filtering as part of a defense-in-depth approach to data security. We are looking for a talented, experienced software engineer to join our team and help take our Data Loss Prevention product to the next level. You’ll help us make our DLP product more efficient and more accurate, while also helping us build out more features. You’ll contribute to the design and implementation of a Rust codebase that is deployed across Cloudflare’s entire edge fleet, and in Kubernetes clusters in our core datacenters. You’ll use AI models to improve how DLP detects, classifies, and protects sensitive data at Cloudflare scale. Technologies we use Core edge services are written in Rust and deployed globally to 300+ data centers. Our REST API is also written in Rust, runs on Kubernetes, and uses Postgres as a data store. For service monitoring we use Prometheus and Grafana For service logging we use Elasticsearch and Kibana For product analytics we use Clickhouse and BigQuery Skills and Knowledge we’d love for you to have Solid Rust coding experience (the entire product is written in Rust) Experience with a variety of AI models. Container orchestration (e.g. k8s) Distributed systems (performance, consistency, observability, resilience) Advanced data/document classification (e.g. statistical, ML) What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers–at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person’s, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer. Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. items.title: Market Curation Editor — Politics
items.summary: The Opportunity As a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch.
items.description: The Opportunity As a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch. An automated pipeline drafts candidate political prediction markets every day; you are the human judgment layer on top of it — deciding which go live, sharpening the ones that are nearly right, and catching the markets the pipeline missed entirely. This role calls for deep, current expertise in politics and elections, and in the conventions that govern how political outcomes are officially called and settled. What You'll Do Review a daily queue of system-generated political markets against a fixed completion deadline, working event by event across every market a political development generates. Assess each candidate market for factual accuracy, clarity, and whether the resolution criteria can actually be adjudicated against a named authoritative source (e.g., the AP, official state election boards, certified results) and a defined settlement date. Verify that open and close timing is correct for the underlying event, including scheduled and unscheduled delays — runoff elections, recounts, and certification delays. Apply the correct settlement convention for the type of political event in question — election calls and concession timing, recounts and certification, runoff triggers, ballot measure outcomes, legislative vote counts, and official statistical or vote-count corrections. Confirm policy fit against community standards and content guidelines, escalating anything ambiguous, contested, or politically sensitive rather than making an unsupported call. Approve, edit, or reject each candidate, recording a structured reason every time — this record is a product deliverable, not admin. Rewrite questions and resolution language for precision, and for how the public and press actually talk about the event. Author timestamped clarifications when ambiguity emerges in a live market, and resolve settlement exceptions the data feed can't handle — contested results, recounts, litigation. Run proactive gap scans — monitor live markets for visible errors, and track campaign schedules, polling releases, and political and press social media for events the pipeline didn't capture. Participate in weekly calibration reviews to stay consistent with published guidelines and fellow curators. What We're Looking For 3+ years in political trading or prediction markets, political data operations, political/data journalism or editorial, polling and election modeling, or a comparable role requiring current subject-matter expertise. Demonstrable current fluency in U.S. politics and elections — following it now, not historically — across federal, state, and major local races. Fluency with political media and political social media (campaign accounts, press pool reporting, breaking political news accounts). Working knowledge of official election administration and settlement conventions (certification timelines, recount thresholds, runoff triggers, Electoral College mechanics where relevant), and of which sources are authoritative for results and vote counts. Proven judgment on edge cases: contested results, recounts, litigation, ballot curing, ambiguous or delayed official calls. Ability to interpret official sources quickly and reach a defensible determination. Exceptional written precision under deadline — able to write unambiguous rules that hold up after the outcome is known. Comfort applying a written policy framework, with the instinct to escalate rather than guess — especially on politically sensitive or contested topics. Flexible availability for evening and weekend work around debates, primaries, and election nights. Nice to Have Direct experience trading on, or working with, political prediction markets or exchanges such as Kalshi or Polymarket. Background in polling and election modeling — for example, FiveThirtyEight during its ABC/ESPN era, Decision Desk HQ, VoteHub, or similar outlets; data-journalism experience of this kind, including at spinoffs such as Fifty Plus One, is also relevant. Prior work on a political trading desk, or standing as a super-user of political prediction apps. Political journalism background and/or experience contributing to guidelines, style guides, rulebooks, or annotation standards. Familiarity with content policy, moderation frameworks, or editorial standards, particularly around politically sensitive content. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote URL: http://wevote.us Help Shape How Millions of Voters Engage with Reliable Civic Information WeVote is a nonpartisan civic technology nonprofit dedicated to increasing voter participation through innovative digital tools and trusted voter education resources. As a Fast Forward nonprofit technology grantee, WeVote empowers voters with the information they need to make informed decisions and participate confidently in democracy. We are seeking a strategic and innovative Director of Content Strategy to lead the development and execution of WeVote's content vision across digital channels. This volunteer leadership role is ideal for an experienced content strategist, communications leader, digital marketer, or media professional who is passionate about civic engagement and audience growth. As Director of Content Strategy, you will define how WeVote communicates with voters, volunteers, supporters, and stakeholders through impactful content initiatives. You will oversee content planning, messaging strategy, editorial priorities, audience engagement efforts, and cross-functional collaboration to expand WeVote's reach and influence. What You'll Do Develop Content Strategy Create and lead a comprehensive content strategy that aligns with WeVote's mission, organizational goals, audience needs, and voter engagement objectives. Drive Audience Growth & Engagement Identify opportunities to expand audience reach, increase engagement, and strengthen relationships with voters, volunteers, donors, and supporters through strategic content initiatives. Lead Content Planning Oversee content roadmaps, editorial calendars, and campaign planning across blogs, newsletters, voter education resources, thought leadership content, and digital communications. Shape Organizational Messaging Develop messaging frameworks and content guidelines that ensure consistency across all channels while reinforcing WeVote's nonpartisan mission and brand voice. Collaborate Across Teams Partner with leaders across Product, Political Data, Communications, Marketing, Partnerships, and Volunteer Recruitment to identify content opportunities and align messaging efforts. Analyze Content Performance Monitor content effectiveness, audience behavior, engagement metrics, and communication trends to continuously improve content strategy and impact. Lead Content Contributors Provide strategic guidance and leadership to volunteer writers, editors, researchers, content creators, and communications team members. Support Thought Leadership Initiatives Help position WeVote as a trusted leader in civic technology, voter education, and democratic participation through compelling storytelling and content innovation. What We're Looking For Content Strategy Experience 3+ years of experience in content strategy, communications, digital marketing, content leadership, audience development, media, publishing, or related fields. Strategic Thinking Demonstrated ability to create and execute content strategies that drive awareness, engagement, audience growth, and organizational impact. Audience & Engagement Expertise Experience understanding audience needs, developing content journeys, and optimizing content performance across digital channels. Strong Communication Skills Exceptional writing, editing, messaging, and storytelling abilities with the ability to translate complex topics into clear, accessible content. Data-Informed Decision Making Comfortable using content analytics, engagement insights, and performance metrics to guide strategic decisions. Cross-Functional Leadership Experience collaborating with diverse stakeholders and managing projects across multiple teams and initiatives. Mission Alignment Passion for democracy, civic engagement, voter education, and leveraging content to create meaningful social impact. Self-Starter Mentality Ability to thrive in a remote, volunteer-driven environment while independently driving strategic initiatives forward. Why Join WeVote? Help shape how millions of voters access and engage with trusted civic information. Lead content strategy for a nationally recognized civic technology nonprofit. Build executive-level experience in digital strategy, communications, and audience development. Collaborate with mission-driven professionals in technology, media, civic engagement, and nonprofit leadership. Make a measurable impact on voter participation and democratic engagement. Position Details Location: Remote (U.S.-based volunteers preferred) Time Commitment: Approximately 5–10 hours per week Compensation: Volunteer Position * Fraud and phishing warning * Please apply directly via our volunteering portal/ATS at https://wevote.applytojob.com/apply. Do not apply via any other job portals, aggregators, or sites, as your information may not be secure, or the role may no longer be accepting applications. Thank you!! items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Yerevan, Remote, Armenia URL: http://capslock.global CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions. At CapsLock , people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success. ﻿Role overview Our creative team produces hundreds of video ads, images and ad copy variations every month, and we test them across our campaigns to find out what works best. Behind all of that is a fast-moving pipeline, and we’re looking for a Creative Marketing Project Coordinator to keep it running smoothly. You’ll be working with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers. You’ll turn ideas and requests into clear tasks, keep everyone aligned on deadlines, review the final work before it goes live, and make sure every asset gets launched and tested. Many of our workflows are already automated, and we’d love someone who enjoys finding smarter ways to work as we grow. If you love bringing order to a busy environment, have a sharp eye for detail and are curious about the creative side of marketing, this role is a great place to grow. You’ll also be invited to brainstorming sessions and can contribute your own ideas to the creative process. Responsibilities Task & Pipeline Management Turn monthly creative requests (videos, images and ad copy) into clear, well-structured tasks in ClickUp (our project management system). Add briefs, guidelines and references to each task, and assign it to the right team member Agree on deadlines with each team and track every task from request to launch Keep an accurate record of all creative tests and their status at every stage Cross-Team Coordination & Follow-Up Communicate daily with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers Follow up proactively so deadlines are met and nothing stalls in the pipeline Flag delays and bottlenecks early and help resolve them Release approved assets to media buyers and confirm they have been received, launched and reviewed Quality Control Review final images, videos and ad copy before launch against briefs, client guidelines and technical specifications Catch typos, formatting errors and visual glitches before assets go live Develop an eye for visual inconsistencies, such as AI-generated artifacts, distorted details or elements that don’t make sense in context Collaborate with team members pipeline to handle 100–350 tasks per month without losing accuracy Suggest improvements to task structure, templates and handoff processes Creative Collaboration Take part in team brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas Turn raw concepts from brainstorms into structured, actionable tasks Build an understanding of our creative work and what performs well, with room to grow into the Confidence in following up with many people across teams while keeping things friendly Sharp eye for detail when reviewing images, videos and ad copy Genuine interest in creative marketing and ad content Technical Skills 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination or process management Hands-on experience with project management tools such as ClickUp, monday.com, Asana or Trello Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) to streamline work Experience in a marketing agency, creative production or e-commerce environment is a plus Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher Soft Skills Thrives on structure and turning chaos into reliable systems Proactive, reliable and consistent with deadlines Clear, professional communicator Adaptable to shifting priorities in a fast-paced team Curious, with the initiative to improve processes and contribute ideas What we offer Remote Work - We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact. Paid vacations - Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge Unlimited Sick Days - We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet. Ongoing Learning - People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more. Home Office - We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience. Physical Well–Being - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally, we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program. Fun Stuff - There is never a shortage of fun stuff To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/capslock-creative-marketing-project-coordinator-1

items.title: Agile Program Manager
items.summary: We're looking for an experienced Agile Program Manager to lead delivery across multiple cross-functional teams working toward a shared set of business outcomes. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution: translating roadmap priorities into coordinated, predictable delivery, keeping dependencies visible, and making sure the right people are making the right decisions at the right time. This is a hands-on program role, not a status-reporting one. You'll own the cadence, the plan, and the risks across several Agile teams, and you'll be the person stakeholders trust to tell them where things really stand. What You'll Do Lead end-to-end delivery of a multi-team program, coordinating three or more Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid) toward shared quarterly objectives. Run program-level planning, including quarterly/PI planning, roadmap alignment, capacity planning, and release planning. Identify, map, and actively manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and blockers, escalating early and with clear options. Facilitate program ceremonies such as Scrum of Scrums, program syncs, system demos, and retrospectives, and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates. Partner with Product Owners and Product Managers to keep backlogs prioritized, refined, and aligned to business value. Build and maintain program-level reporting: delivery health, burn-up/velocity trends, OKR or objective progress, and RAID logs, tailored for both team-level and executive audiences. Drive continuous improvement in delivery practices, tooling, and team workflows, coaching teams and leaders on Agile principles where needed. Manage stakeholder communication across engineering, product, design, business, and leadership, keeping expectations aligned as scope and priorities shift. Track program budget, resourcing, and vendor or third-party deliverables where applicable. What You Bring 8+ years of experience in program or project management, with at least 5 years leading delivery in Agile environments. Proven track record managing multi-team programs (not just single-team Scrum) from planning through release. Deep, practical knowledge of Scrum and Kanban, plus experience with at least one scaling framework (SAFe, LeSS, Scrum@Scale, or similar). Strong command of Agile tooling such as Jira, Jira Align, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent, including building dashboards and program-level reporting. Excellent facilitation skills: you can run a 50-person planning event as comfortably as a tense 1:1 escalation. Clear, concise written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to tailor the message for engineers and executives alike. Experience working with distributed or remote teams across time zones. Comfort operating with ambiguity: you can stand up structure where there is none and adapt it as the program evolves. Nice to Have Agile or program management certifications such as SAFe RTE, SAFe SPC, PMI-ACP, PgMP, PMP, CSM/CSP, or ICAgile. Experience with Agile transformations or introducing scaled frameworks into an organization. Background in software, SaaS, data, or digital product delivery. Familiarity with OKRs and value-stream or portfolio management. Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, insurance, public sector) where Agile delivery coexists with compliance requirements. Budget and vendor management experience on programs with multiple delivery partners. items.summary: Position Type : Full-time Location: Philippines (Remote) Schedule: Mon-Fri, EST About the Company Our client is a global leader in swimming pool technology, specializing in robotic pool cleaners, pool safety products, water treatment solutions, and related pool equipment for residential and commercial customers. With a strong international presence and a network of distributors, subsidiaries, and partners across multiple markets, our client serves customers worldwide through a variety of sales and distribution channels. About the Role Our client is looking for a Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst to monitor online marketplaces and digital channels across North America and Europe. The role focuses on identifying unauthorized sellers, marketplace and distribution violations, misuse of brand assets, and other compliance issues. You will conduct online research, analyze seller and product data, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports that provide actionable insights to the business. Responsibilities Monitor Amazon, eBay, Walmart, BestBuy, Home Depot, AliExpress, Temu, and other major marketplaces. Research products and identify new or unauthorized sellers. Classify sellers and verify their authorization status. Identify MAP, distribution, territory, and marketplace compliance issues. Monitor unauthorized use of logos, images, trademarks, and product content. Collect evidence such as URLs, screenshots, seller information, and product details. Maintain accurate seller databases and internal records. Prepare daily reports and monthly Voice of Consumer reports. Build and maintain dashboards tracking brand-protection metrics. Identify opportunities to improve research and reporting processes. Competencies and Qualifications Must-Have 3+ years of experience in data analysis, online research, e-commerce, compliance, or a related field. Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables. items.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re seeking a Principal Software Engineer to contribute to the technical architecture, design and development of Fivetran’s Managed Data Lake product offering. As part of a senior engineering team, you’ll partner with product and engineering teams to build scalable, high-performance systems, advance open-source technologies, and set technical standards that raise the bar across the organization.
 

This is a full-time remote position based out of Germany. 

Technologies You’ll Use

  • Java, C++, Postgres, Temporal, gRPC
  • AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Grafana
  • Iceberg, Polaris, Delta Lake, Parquet, DuckDB

What You’ll Do

  • Partner closely with product teams to understand requirements and design cutting-edge new capabilities that go directly into customer’s hands.
  • Design, develop, implement, and operate highly reliable large-scale data lake systems in cooperation with a dedicated data lake engineering team.
  • Contribute to open-source projects such as DuckDB and Polaris.
  • Embrace Fivetran innovations with open-source standards and toolsets.
  • Analyze fault-tolerance and high availability issues, performance and scale challenges, and solve them.
  • Ensure operational excellence of the services and meet the commitments to our customers regarding security, reliability, availability, and performance.
  • Set technical directions and influence cross-functional teams.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of hands-on or research experience with high-performance relational data management systems.
  • Deep understanding of infrastructure & software optimizations and performance engineering to drive significant performance, latency, and availability improvements.
  • Proven track record of leading and delivering large and complicated projects.
  • Strong development skills in Java and C++.
  • Solid experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Demonstrated knowledge of columnar storage formats.
  • Growth mindset and excitement about breaking the status quo by seeking innovative solutions.
  • Excellent team player who is consistent in making everyone around you better.

Bonus Skills

  • Strongly prefer an MS or PhD in Computer Science, ideally focusing on database management and/or storage engines.

#LI-IM1
#LI-REMOTE

 

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.     

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video.

To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here.

We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form. We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.
